summary: The series' convenience chain appears in Key Lento in Trailer 2 and is robbed by Jason in an official site video.
Shop sign with the number 305-555-0178, next to a grocery open 24/7, in an Extended Look street scene.
Ambrosia's sugar refinery, which 'provides the jobs' according to the official site's location text.
The series' gun shop returns in Trailer 2 via a store sign and a commercial featuring a Phil Cassidy lookalike.
Fictional pill advertised in Trailer 1 as something that 'cures emotions'.
Named as a location category on the official IGN / MapGenie GTA VI map of Leonida.
Tyre brand moulded into the Riata's tyre in official vehicle imagery.

title: Fictional crypto brand AudaCity and DacityCoin appears on a plane in the launch trailer
summary: The GTA VI launch trailer shows a plane reading 'DacityCoin AudaCity', a fictional meme-coin brand. Decrypt says leaked footage had Lucia skydiving in an AudaCity parachute, and the GTA wiki describes the stunt as advertising the brand and the coin. A real Solana token of the same name rose sharply after the trailer. Rockstar did not respond to Decrypt about it.
Beige shapewear features on Rockstar's GTA VI tour-bus ads, billboards and digital displays in Miami. A widely shared fan post paired it with SKIMS.
24/7's supersized fountain drink, first seen in GTA Online, on a Port Gellhorn billboard in Trailer 2 and advertised on a real Miami kiosk.

A Vice City shop whose sign promises sushi and ramen but which is a coffee shop inside, where 'sushi' and 'ramen' are names for its bread. 'Bimyou' translates as 'mediocre', a jab at pricey US spots that misuse Japanese food and words.
Irish-themed stout from GTA IV and GTA V, spotted in the Extended Look.
American muscle and truck brand behind the Banshee, Gauntlet Hellfire and Buffalo STX in official material.
GTA VI's money app: its logo sits on the HUD next to banked cash and it has a billboard in An Extended Look. Bloomberg's review calls it the game's version of Venmo.
GTA's burger chain, first seen in Vice City, was made real as a food stand inside Miami's Kaseya Center in October 2026, with kiosk and billboard ads around the city.
GTA IV's Mexican beer returns, in cases at Uncle Jack's Liquor in Trailer 1 and as cans in promo screenshots.
Fast-food chain whose Prairie Sandwich and Lasso Fries lampoon Arby's menu in a TV ad in the Extended Look (spelt Chasey's in some write-ups).
The chicken chain from San Andreas got a real food stand inside Miami's Kaseya Center in October 2026.

Tesla-style EV brand from GTA V, advertised in Rockstar's October 2026 Miami campaign, including Raiden kiosk ads. IGN's Rhiannon Bevan tested the cars in-game and found that trying to steal a Coil locks you inside, after which the car either drives itself to the nearest police station or waits for the police. Consequence, citing player footage, calls the feature an Autonomous Security System. You can escape by breaking a window, IGN says, and the mechanic was not found on other Tesla-like electric cars in the game.
The series' luxury watch brand, seen in earlier games including GTA V, is back on Rockstar's GTA VI tour-bus ads, billboards and digital displays in Miami.
Maker of the Tulip, Jason and Lucia's getaway car in Trailer 2's final shot.
In-game name with an All Delights Dancers Card Locations page in the IGN official strategy guide. Also appears as a category on the official IGN / MapGenie map.
Jewellery store front reading Quality jewels and watches on a Vice City corner in official footage.
Fictional makeup brand on Rockstar's real-world Miami ads, including a multi-storey downtown building wrap of red lips and a lipstick with the line "These are Dix lips" and a QR code.
Art deco hotel in Trailer 2, with tables under pink awnings.
Coca-Cola stand-in seen on Uncle Jack's Liquor shelves in Trailer 1, in Brian's hand in an official site video and on a liquor store clock in the Extended Look.
Rooftop bar where Jason and Lucia meet Brian Heder in the Extended Look.
Named tattoo studio in official Ultimate Edition material, listed by Leonidaguide as written by Rockstar.

Nike-style sportswear brand from GTA IV and V, on a dirt biker's trainers in Trailer 1 and maker of the Manatees jersey Dre'Quan wears. In the game it also has a sneaker line. GQ, on 19 November 2026, names models including the Rise Low, Strife 360, Strife 90 and Rook 1 High. An in-game sponsored post from the brand's @ERIS account introduces a shoe called the Strife.
New fizzy orange drink with a near copy of Fanta's logo, seen in store packs in Trailer 2, floating by Cal in a pool on the official site and on an Extended Look poster.
New spicy snack on Uncle Jack's shelves in Trailer 1, later on a Mule truck livery in the Extended Look.
Bank whose credit card ads appear in Trailer 1 and whose Vice City branches are robbed in the Extended Look.
Airline from GTA IV and V whose refreshed livery is on a jet landing at VCIA in Trailer 2.
Green Food Mart sign above a gas-station convenience store in an Extended Look robbery.
Heinz-style ketchup spotted by fans in pre-release GTA VI footage. Heinz answered on 19 November with real GORGE bottles for an Instagram giveaway, with no Rockstar deal.
Italian supercar maker whose 1995 Cheetah appears in Trailer 1, with the Furia also confirmed in official material.
The security firm's armoured car appears in the Extended Look.
Port Gellhorn waffle diner robbed by Jason and Lucia in the Extended Look; its car park appears in Trailer 2.
Named as a location category on the official IGN / MapGenie GTA VI map of Leonida.
Neon hotel sign in official Vice City screenshots.
Still the main phone brand, held by Jason and Lucia in official screenshots and advertised on a real Wynwood kiosk.
Boobie Ike's Crosstown strip club, whose takings bankroll Only Raw Records.
New tube-packed crisps seen in Uncle Jack's in Trailer 1, The Rusty Anchor in Trailer 2 and stores in the Extended Look.

The games console in Jason and Lucia's home, which runs playable parody mini-games. Kotaku names it but does not say outright that it parodies PlayStation. GameSpot is the sourced comparison with PlayStation.
Fictional juice brand on a downtown Miami billboard, with a smiling orange mascot and the slogan "Keeping America on the move!", which reads like a laxative joke.
Named as a location category on the official IGN / MapGenie GTA VI map of Leonida.
Named as a location category on the official IGN / MapGenie GTA VI map of Leonida.
Upmarket brand on a Waning Sands shopping mall sign in Trailer 1.
The series' watch brand returned on Rockstar's Wynwood digital kiosks in October 2026 with the tagline "Always Come Early", alongside Pfister, Kowalski, Grotti, Vapid and Weazel News ads.
Named as a location category on the official IGN / MapGenie GTA VI map of Leonida.
New Mexican-style beer whose name means dishwater, seen on Uncle Jack's shelves in Trailer 1 and on a billboard and Jason's coffee table in Trailer 2.
Familiar GTA lager that is now a consumable, offered from Lucia's fridge in the Extended Look and held by Jason in an official screenshot.

Cartoon gator from the in-game kids' show Macca & Friends, star of the Ultimate Edition's Goodtime Gear and the Vice City Collection merchandise. A roughly 30-second Macca & Friends teaser debuted as a DiscussingFilm exclusive on 13 November, following a Miami billboard saying the show is "Coming November 19 on Weazel". Rockstar reshared the teaser on its own account, and GTA BOOM reports that the animated series airs inside the game on the fictional WEAZEL network, which players can watch on in-game TVs from 19 November.
New burger and milkshake chain glimpsed beside a 24/7 in Key Lento in Trailer 2 and on a takeaway bag in a promo screenshot.
Megamundo's news arm, whose report on a Leonida man's arrest airs in Trailer 1.
Spanish-language broadcaster first named in a Mega Noticias report in Trailer 1; its Downtown building appears in Trailer 2 and its interior in the Extended Look.
Superclub teased on a plane banner in Trailer 1 and danced in during Trailer 2 and the Extended Look.
Neon hotel sign in official Vice City screenshots.
Named garage in official Ultimate Edition material, listed by Leonidaguide as written by Rockstar.
Hip-hop label run by Dre'Quan Priest and funded by Boobie Ike, home of Real Dimez.
Flavoured vodka in bottles and boxes on Uncle Jack's shelves, its circumflex nodding to Cîroc and its name to 'pillock'.
Redesigned all-American lager on a box trailer in Trailer 1's opening shot. Ads ran outside Miami bars and labels were filed for a real version, though real sales are unconfirmed.
Vehicle repair and respray facilities in Leonida, described in the IGN official Beginner's Guide and How to Repair Your Vehicle pages.
In-game name with a PeeWee Billboards page in the IGN official strategy guide. GTA Wiki records Peewees as a chicken restaurant visible in official Extended Look footage.
German sports car maker whose Comet S2 Cabrio is confirmed in official material.
Returning crisp brand from GTA IV and V, seen in bags on Uncle Jack's shelves in Trailer 1.

The long-running German-style lager returns in an official screenshot and in-game stores, and was advertised outside real Miami bars. A filing and Tripping Animals Brewing images suggest a real-life version, but sales are not confirmed.
Alcohol-free spin-off of Pißwasser, reported on a billboard. Gameranx did not say which official material showed it, and GTA Wiki lists it inconsistently, so treat as unconfirmed.
New Mexican lager whose name riffs on 'pendejo', shown on a liquor store poster and clinked by Jason and Lucia in Trailer 2.
Round Postal shipping logo on a store window in the Extended Look, a shortened form of the series' GoPostal.
GTA sportswear label from San Andreas onwards, seen on a basketball and trainers in the Extended Look.
Named stash house in official Ultimate Edition material, listed by Leonidaguide as written by Rockstar. Also appears as a category on the official IGN / MapGenie map.
Jamaican rum with a new bottle, advertised at $16.99 on Uncle Jack's door in Trailer 1 and on liquor store shelves in the Extended Look.
New sports drink seen in a Xero minimart fridge and on stock car liveries at a raceway in the Extended Look.
Cigarette brand on the visor of Wyman, the Ultimate Edition collector, in official edition material.
Named garage in official Ultimate Edition material, listed by Leonidaguide as written by Rockstar.
In-world shooter game on a gang member's shirt and a console home screen in the Extended Look.
Rum brand on a poster reading Make the smoothest rum in the Extended Look liquor store. The tracker also lists Ragga Rum from other official material; they may be two different rums.
Ride-share app that Game Informer says lets players reach destinations quickly, promoted with a wrapped Toyota Corolla in Miami.
Delivery company whose Sahara Mirage boxes appear in an official screenshot and in An Extended Look. Bloomberg's review describes a Sahara delivery truck as the game's parody of Amazon.
Downtown Vice City arena of the Narcos, seen from the interstate in Trailer 1 and again in the Extended Look.
Named as a location category on the official IGN / MapGenie GTA VI map of Leonida.
Named beauty salon in official Ultimate Edition material, listed by Leonidaguide as written by Rockstar.
Monogrammed GTA V fashion house seen on a bikini in Trailer 1, and on framed posters and Lucia's belt buckle in the Extended Look.
Downtown Vice City bank that Jason and Lucia rob in a heist shown in Trailer 2.

An in-game magazine article, 'AI Solves Russo's Assassination', says it prompted a tool called Slop.AI to re-examine a frame from the 'Zandford film' of President Joe S. Russo's assassination, using mock methods including forensic inflatable-flamingo analysis and 'cutting-edge rumba science'. The name plays on 'AI slop' and is widely read as a parody of ChatGPT and OpenAI. First widely shared in a screenshot posted by ElijahOutWest on 25 November 2026.
Instagram-style social app on the in-game phone, carried over from GTA V.
The series' lemon-lime soda appears in convenience stores robbed in the Extended Look, at Xero and in a safehouse fridge, and was advertised on a real Wynwood kiosk.
Named clothing store in official Ultimate Edition material, listed by Leonidaguide as written by Rockstar.
GTA V's Los Santos taco chain returns on a Rockstar GTA VI tour-bus ad in Miami.

A playable black-and-white puzzle game set on an island with a lighthouse, which Cal sets up on a console in Jason's living room. It is credited almost entirely to a fictional auteur, Johannes Zuch, and satirises pretentious auteur-led games.
New hard seltzer: a pink can priced at $2.50 on Uncle Jack's door in Trailer 1, and held by a woman on the official cover art.
Key Lento waterside bar where Jason, Lucia and Cal hang out in Trailer 2.
Club glimpsed unnamed in Trailer 1 and shown in the Extended Look, later advertised on boats and kiosks in Miami.
Cake brand on an Ambrosia billboard in an official screenshot and on Boxville truck liveries in the Extended Look.
'Everyone's Favorite Uncle' liquor chain that Jason and Lucia walk round and then burst into with guns drawn in Trailer 1.
Ford stand-in with multiple models seen in trailer footage and screenshots.
Aqua-kitted football team whose jersey appears in Trailer 2, on Dre'Quan and on the cover art.
Basketball side whose cap Dre'Quan wears in Trailer 2, with its logo on the Sahara Arena in screenshots.
Phone app that scans vehicles to show a car's type, security features and whether it has a tracker. Business Insider calls it vaguely Carvana-ish; Rockstar has not explained the name.
A parts-store sign, with a phone number, in Trailer 2.
Redesigned news network graphics in Trailer 1 and official screenshots, later on real Miami kiosks and Freebee cars.
The WhatsApp-like messenger on the in-game phone. WhatsApp itself borrowed the name and blue three-dot icon for its X account on launch day.
Pink street food truck reading WTF, seen beside Diamond Dawgs in official Extended Look footage, as noted by Leonidaguide.
Wyman's salvage yard, printed on his tank top in official material.
Petrol brand whose motor oil sits in Brian's marina in Trailer 2 and whose forecourts get robbed in the Extended Look.
New citrus soda sold in green and orange shrink-wrapped packs at Uncle Jack's Liquor.
In-game consumable covered by the IGN official strategy guide page Where to Get More Zombix and Adrenaline.

title: NBA 2K27 confirms a Vice City Season 3 with Rockstar
summary: 2K confirmed a 'first-of-its-kind partnership with Rockstar Games': NBA 2K27 Season 3 plays from 27 November 2026 to 15 January 2027, with a Vice City-inspired park, the Sahara Arena and Bam Adebayo on the limited Vice City Edition cover. An official NBA 2K trailer posted on 25 November, branded Vice City Edition, shows the Pro Pass rewards, including a Nike x Cactus Jack 'Vice City' swingman jersey at level 21, a Cluckin' Bell employee outfit at level 36 and Macca the Gator at level 39. The season rewards track adds a Burger Shot employee outfit at level 38, a Rockstar Games sweatshirt at level 36 and a Sprunk race suit at level 39. A $39.99 Vice City Edition includes the Season 3 Pro Pass, and GTA+ members on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S can play the Standard Edition at no extra cost during the season.

title: Miami skate shop Andrew drops a 20-piece GTA VI capsule
summary: Andrew, a Miami skate shop, released a limited 20-piece GTA VI capsule of jackets, jerseys, tees, hoodies, hats and dog toys online and in store at noon ET. Resell Calendar calls it an official capsule with Rockstar, but Rockstar has not confirmed the tie-up and reported prices come from a leaked catalogue.

title: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album with Atlantic Records
summary: Rockstar and Atlantic Records announced a 34-track album of original music, out on 19 November alongside the game, with six singles released straight away and pre-saves open. Artists on the first singles include Travis Scott, Future, Keith Richards, PinkPantheress and Morgan Wallen. On 14 November Billboard published the full 34-song tracklist after photos of the vinyl edition surfaced online, saying sources close to the project confirmed it; artists include Dua Lipa, Lana Del Rey, Cardi B, Playboi Carti, Gunna, Fred again.., Tame Impala and Justice. Billboard reports the album will be sold through retailers including Blood Records, Best Buy, Walmart, Amazon, Barnes & Noble, Target and Urban Outfitters, each with its own exclusive vinyl pressing and poster. On 22 November Push Square reported that the album set a new opening-day record for a soundtrack on Spotify, with 29.85 million streams, citing a Pop Base post. On 23 November Variety reported a deluxe edition with 23 more original songs, and published the official deluxe tracklist, including new tracks from Travis Scott, Slayyyter, 21 Savage, Offset and Latto.

title: Deluxe edition of GTA VI: The Album adds 23 original songs
summary: Variety reports that Atlantic Records and Rockstar Games have added 23 original songs to a deluxe edition of Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album. Variety says the original 34-track album arrived on 20 November, alongside the game. The official deluxe tracklist of 23 songs opens with Travis Scott's 'Burn This Shit Down' and Slayyyter's 'internet $tar', and includes new tracks from 21 Savage, Offset, Latto, Anitta, Denzel Curry, Overmono, Sexyy Red, Pooh Shiesty, The Dare, HEALTH, Kodak Black, Young Nudy, Chris Stassy and Power Trip.

title: Rockstar-sponsored BAYO block party in Little Haiti
summary: Rockstar Games is sponsoring BAYO's free 10th-anniversary show in Miami's Little Haiti on 22 November. Hoodline reports that BAYO's tour FAQ says all tickets are free through a raffle at bayotour.com, courtesy of Rockstar Games, with no other tickets sold, and that Axios reported the partnership.

title: My Best Buy GTA VI pre-order rewards
summary: My Best Buy Plus and Total members get 10% back in rewards on GTA VI pre-orders until 18 November, and any member who pre-orders and also buys an eligible PS5 or Xbox Series X|S gets a $50 certificate. The certificate is issued around 25 November and cannot be used on either purchase.

brand: Best Buy, Walmart, Amazon, Target, Barnes & Noble, Urban Outfitters, Blood Records
title: Retailer-exclusive vinyl colourways for GTA VI: The Album
summary: With the album announcement came retailer-exclusive vinyl colourways, each with new artwork, at Blood Records, Best Buy, Walmart, Amazon, Barnes & Noble, Target, Urban Outfitters and independent shops. A liquid-filled vinyl, a splatter vinyl and a CD jewel case were sold only via the official album site.

title: GTA VI-wrapped sightseeing buses
summary: Sightseeing buses wrapped in GTA VI art were reported in New York and Chicago, and in Miami along with a separate "I Love Vice City" bus. One site names Big Bus as the operator, but this has not been confirmed.

brand: Burger Shot / Cluckin' Bell (Kaseya Center concessions)
title: Real Burger Shot opens at Kaseya Center, then across Florida with Skinny Louie
summary: Versions of the in-game fast food chains opened as concession stands inside Kaseya Center. The HEAT lists Burger Shot at sections 105, 120, 308 and 324 and Cluckin' Bell at section 325. Reports say Burger Shot took over a Skinny Louie stand, with staff in GTA-style uniforms. IGN reports that from 13 November to 31 December Burger Shot is expanding to Skinny Louie's standalone stores across Florida, with Burger Shot signage, uniforms and a game-themed menu including The Bleeder triple smash burger and a caramel milkshake.

title: Cactus Jack x Grand Theft Auto VI tees and apparel
summary: The official Cactus Jack shop is selling a Grand Theft Auto VI apparel range. Confirmed tee prices include the Logo Vice City Tee, Jack of Hearts Security Tee and I Didn't Work Today Tee at $55, the Leonida Collage Tee at $60, the Cactus Jack Nike x Grand Theft Auto VI x Miami Heat Athletic Dept Tee at $58, and the Vice City women's baby tee at $52. An apparel collection had already been mentioned in the Air Force 1 entry, with pieces on Nike SNKRS from 21 November and more on the Cactus Jack shop from 23 November.

brand: City of Miami Beach / Boucher Brothers
title: Vice City beach chairs and umbrellas on Miami Beach
summary: On 10 September Miami Beach commissioners voted 4 to 3 to let the city negotiate a deal with Amplify Marketing, Rockstar's agency, for VI and Vice City branding on Boucher Brothers beach chairs and umbrellas, reported to be worth $3m to $4m. Branded gear began arriving on South Beach around 14 October, although the contract was reported as still unsigned at that point. On 28 October Miami-Dade County said Miami Beach had completed advertising arrangements, including advertising on beach concession equipment.

title: Downtown Miami GTA VI banners
summary: A proposed City of Miami ordinance, reported on 5 September, would allow up to six GTA VI banners downtown at $202,000 each, between 15 October and 31 December. It needed commission approval, Take-Two sign-off and agreement from downtown residents' associations. On 28 October Miami-Dade County said the City of Miami had completed advertising arrangements tied to the game's release, including temporary promotional banners in Downtown Miami.

title: Hand-painted Jason and Lucia mural in Williamsburg
summary: Colossal Media hand-painted a Jason and Lucia mural at Wythe Avenue and North 11th Street in Williamsburg, a corner that carried a GTA V mural in 2013, two decades after its first Rockstar work on GTA San Andreas. Around 3 November graffiti artist Jelous tagged its lower half, which drew criticism from fans. In an interview with Brick and Grit he said he did not go over a mural but tagged an advertisement, and Dexerto and GTA BOOM report he has since tagged a second GTA VI ad.

title: GTA VI dummy cases and posters in UK shops
summary: Official empty GTA VI display cases and posters were photographed in Currys and Smyths Toys stores in the UK on 23 September. Neither retailer nor Rockstar has commented, and specific branches were not named.

title: Jason and Lucia cover Dazed "New Idols" issue
summary: Dazed's "New Idols" issue put Jason and Lucia on the cover, with original artwork made by Rockstar, fashion by Rockstar's in-house team and interviews with Rob Nelson of Rockstar North and Rupert Humphries, Rockstar's senior vice president of narrative.

title: Discord Quest rewards Nitro for watching Trailer 2
summary: Discord ran a Quest that gave users one day of Nitro for watching the second GTA VI trailer in the app.

title: Discord adds a GTA VI Vice City theme and app icon
summary: Discord announced on X on 16 November a free Vice City makeover with Rockstar Games for GTA VI: a Vice City colour theme, matching app icon and Display Name Style. It is available to everyone until 13 December and to Nitro members (excluding Nitro Basic) until 20 February 2027. Datamined code under the codename "Hexagon" had pointed to the campaign beforehand.

title: Coulda Been Records episode presented by GTA VI
summary: Druski's "OLD HEADS" auditions episode with Ali G, published on YouTube on 23 October 2026 (Pacific time), included an announcement saying it was presented by GTA VI from Rockstar Games, encouraging viewers to pre-order the Ultimate Edition. The video description links to Rockstar's pre-order page. The only explicit sponsorship disclosure is for SeatGeek. Neither Rockstar nor Druski has publicly confirmed a commercial agreement.

title: Edge issue 430 GTA VI special with gatefold cover
summary: Edge issue 430 ran a 16-page GTA VI cover story after visiting Rockstar North in Edinburgh, with a double-sided gatefold Jason and Lucia cover. The feature was also published free online on GamesRadar+ on 29 October.

title: EE pre-orders and PS5/Xbox GTA VI bundles
summary: UK network EE opened GTA VI pre-orders on 6 July with an add-to-plan offer of £5 a month plus £13 upfront, and bundles with PS5 Pro (£808), PS5 Disc (£588) and Xbox Series X (£543).

title: Pitchside LED ads during El Clasico
summary: Pitchside LED boards at Spotify Camp Nou showed the GTA VI logo and "Coming November 19" during Barcelona v Real Madrid on 25 October. The report is based on fan footage; there is no statement from Rockstar or the club.

title: Freebee electric shuttles in game liveries
summary: About 20 Freebee electric vans and cars were reported wrapped in Weazel News and Vice City liveries, running until 7 January 2027. No primary source or official confirmation was found.

title: Game Informer 14-page GTA VI cover story
summary: Game Informer revealed a GTA VI cover for issue 382 with a 14-page story, available digitally from 29 September, and Rockstar promoted the issue on its own channels.

title: Goodyear blimp in Vice City livery
summary: Wingfoot Three left Ohio on 12 October in a Vice City livery, heading south towards Florida. On 3 November Goodyear confirmed a blimp with "a special Grand Theft Auto VI livery created in collaboration with Rockstar Games" would fly over Homestead-Miami Speedway for NASCAR Championship Weekend, 6 to 8 November.

title: "In for VI" message at Dolphins v Bengals
summary: An "In for VI" message with the GTA VI logo and release date was reported on the stadium screens during Dolphins v Bengals on 11 October. No primary source or official confirmation was found.

title: Agency Heroiks runs GTA VI's national media campaign in France
summary: French trade title Stratégies reported on 12 November that media agency Heroiks is rolling out the national media campaign in France for GTA VI's launch. CB News (11 November) confirms the national campaign and says Heroiks designed a multi-channel plan across television, streaming (TF1+, M6+ and Canal+) and digital. Stratégies is paywalled and was not readable, so spend and flight dates are not confirmed here.

title: GTA VI-wrapped Ding Ding tram
summary: A double-deck tram wrapped in GTA VI colours, showing the release date in Chinese, was reported in Hong Kong on 30 October. No primary source or official confirmation was found.

title: IGN hosts the Official Online Guide for GTA VI, made with Rockstar
summary: IGN Entertainment released its free Official Online Guide for GTA VI on IGN.com, made in direct collaboration with Rockstar Games, alongside the game's 19 November launch. Rockstar publicly linked to it as the official guide. At launch it covered the first two chapters with an interactive map of Leonida built on IGN's MapGenie platform, checklist trackers and mission and mechanics guides, with more to follow. IGN's Peer Schneider said the guide is spoiler-safe.

title: DJ Stevie J takes over iHeartRadio Hip-Hop stations for Black Friday
summary: On Black Friday, 27 November, DJ Stevie J takes over iHeartRadio's Hip-Hop stations from 5pm, playing a mix of rap tracks from the GTA VI: The Album soundtrack and debuting two new songs, 'OMC' and 'SIU'. Stevie J voices the resident DJ at VYB Nightclub on Vice Beach in GTA VI, a character based on his real job as head DJ at LIV Miami, where he performs weekly.

title: Launch trailer debuts Justice single "Flower in a Hurricane"
summary: The launch trailer, released on 15 October, confirmed French duo Justice as composers of the game's score and debuted their single "Flower in a Hurricane" featuring Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard. The track is also on GTA VI: The Album.

title: GTA VI Original Score by Justice and "Pusher" single
summary: Rockstar announced Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score by Justice, 30 tracks plus digital bonus tracks, out 11 December on streaming, CD and vinyl. The single "Pusher" with Gesaffelstein came out the same day.

title: LOVE issue 27 GTA VI cover
summary: LOVE issue 27 had a Jason and Lucia cover with new official images and quotes from Rockstar staff, on newsstands from 5 October at €25. GTA BOOM reported it sold out within minutes of pre-orders via distributor KD Presse.

title: MediaMarkt and Saturn roll out in-store GTA VI promotion
summary: MediaMarkt and Saturn launched GTA VI landing pages and put displays, posters, pre-order boxes and in-store TV promotion into branches; PlayStation shop-in-shop areas were also redesigned in GTA style. Monsterdealz reports that from 12 November MediaMarkt is selling a limited non-alcoholic launch beer called 'LOS LENTOS' for one euro a bottle in 30 stores across 19 German cities, with a wheel-of-fortune roadshow visiting five of them, starting at Munich Stachus on 12 November. Buyers of the boxed game at MediaMarkt also get a double-sided GTA VI poster.

title: "Welcome to Vice City" rooftop sign on Kaseya Center
summary: Large "Welcome to Vice City" lettering was installed on the roof of Kaseya Center on 22 September. It stems from a deal worth almost $1m between Miami-Dade County and Rockstar, signed by Mayor Daniella Levine Cava under her authority for contracts under $1m, without a commission vote. The money is earmarked for developing county land behind the arena.

title: GTA VI ads at Miami airport, PortMiami and on traffic signal cabinets
summary: Miami-Dade County announced a $3.9m set of ad deals with Rockstar, covering GTA VI displays on Miami International Airport walkways, advertising at PortMiami and themed wraps on traffic signal cabinets, alongside the earlier $975,000 Kaseya Center sign. Rockstar pays to install and remove everything and the money goes to a long-stalled park behind Kaseya Center, though the sheriff and some commissioners criticised the deal.

title: HEAT "Vice City" apparel collection
summary: The Miami HEAT Store sells a Court Culture Vice City collection in store and online, including tees, a crop top, a hoodie, a crewneck and New Era caps, priced from $45 to $110. Several pieces are Court Culture x Duvin collaborations, such as a Vice City Pool Service pocket tee.

title: Miami HEAT "A Night in Vice City" partnership
summary: On 2 October the HEAT announced "A Night in Vice City" for 18 November, the eve of launch, against the Milwaukee Bucks at Kaseya Center on a one-off court. On 6 November it revealed the Nike x Cactus Jack "Vice City" uniform. On the night, the HEAT played as the Vice City Heat; fans queued in the rain for the merch, $120 Vice City jerseys were limited to one per ticket, and reporter Cameron Wolfe said all the HEAT x Vice City gear sold out in under 90 minutes. Macca the Gator, from an in-game GTA VI cartoon, appeared on court. A HEAT representative later said the team sold more than $1.5 million of Vice City merchandise that evening, and the Vice City Heat beat the Bucks 137-130.

title: First GTA VI TV spot airs on NBA opening night
summary: The first GTA VI TV ad, a cut-down of the launch trailer, aired on 20 October during NBA opening night, with viewers spotting it during Knicks v 76ers. Two of the trailer's three shower scenes and the Xbox logo were cut, and some shots were lengthened.

title: "An Extended Look" gameplay showcase premieres on Netflix
summary: Rockstar and Netflix announced on 6 August that GTA VI: An Extended Look would premiere first on Netflix on 27 August at 3pm ET, then go up on Rockstar's YouTube channel at 9pm ET, about six hours later.

title: Cactus Jack x Rockstar x Nike Air Force 1 Low
summary: On 5 November Travis Scott showed a black, camo and pink Air Force 1 Low with "GTA" on the midsole and six Wanted stars, saying only a few pairs were made for fans and friends. Complex confirms Travis Scott unveiled the Cactus Jack x Rockstar Games x Nike shoe on Instagram. Sneaker Bar Detroit reports the White and Black pairs release on 21 November via a SNKRS app raffle, expected at $130 each, while the multi-colour pair stays Friends and Family only, limited to 600 pairs. Citing Cactus Jack's Instagram, it adds a GTA 6 apparel collection of tees and hoodies on Nike SNKRS on 21 November at 10am ET, with more pieces on cactusjack.com from 23 November. A Cactus Jack pop-up styled as a bank vault opened at 2300 N Miami Ave in Miami from 19 to 22 November (11am to 6pm daily), selling the Air Force 1 Low, Vice City Jersey, Nike, GTA 6 and Miami Heat collections, according to Sneaker News. On 24 November at 5pm ET, Travis Scott opened a public raffle on his own website for all three Air Force 1 Lows, including the previously friends-and-family-only multi-colour "Gradient Camo" pair (limited to 600 numbered pairs): entrants play a mini-game to collect six AF1 pairs before they can enter, according to Sole Retriever.

title: Giannis previews a GTA VI-inspired Nike Freak 8 for the HEAT's 'A Night in Vice City'
summary: Miami HEAT star Giannis Antetokounmpo previewed a player-exclusive Nike Freak 8 with a pink-to-black gradient matching the Nike x Cactus Jack Vice City jerseys, ahead of the HEAT's 'A Night in Vice City' game against the Bucks on 18 November, the day after GTA VI's launch. The HEAT won 137-130, with Giannis recording 27 points, 14 rebounds and 9 assists against his former team. The shoe is not a retail release and carries no direct GTA branding.

title: "The Goodtime State" Vice City Collection collector's box
summary: Rockstar opened pre-orders on 24 September for a $399.99 collectible set themed on the in-game TV show Macca the Gator. It includes GTA VI Oakley Frogskins sunglasses, a New Era 9FORTY cap and a Macca figure among other items. The game is not included.

title: Panini and Rockstar announce the GTA VI Sports Trading Card Collection
summary: On 24 November 2026, Panini America announced a partnership with Rockstar Games for officially licensed trading cards, the GTA VI: Sports Trading Card Collection, going on sale 18 December 2026. The collection features real-world versions of in-game card collectibles found throughout the world of Grand Theft Auto VI, built around fictional sports stars and teams, mixing stylised artwork with in-game character renders. The 70-card base set breaks down into 30 normal cards, 9 illustrated, 9 retro, 10 rookie and 12 wrestling cards, plus Legend and Legacy parallels in Bronze (numbered to 49), Silver (numbered to 25) and 1-of-1 Gold. Each four-pack hobby box includes on average two Rookies, one Retro, one Illustrated and four Special Silvers, plus rare-numbered cards and team colour parallels including Silver, Pink, Teal and Light Blue. Panini has still not announced pricing or which regions beyond the US will get the set.

title: GTA VI theatre at the PlayStation booth, Tokyo Game Show 2026
source_name: Sony Interactive Entertainment Japan press release (Digital PR Platform)
summary: Sony's Tokyo Game Show booth (17 to 21 September) screened the Extended Look on a 300-inch screen with floor haptics that vibrate in time with the footage. Viewers received a limited "Grand Theft Auto VI | PlayStation" T-shirt, one per person, size L only.

title: "It Happens on PS5" digital billboards in Tokyo
summary: Large digital billboards in a busy Tokyo shopping district showed Sony's "It Happens on PS5" ads, with GTA VI given prominence next to Sony's own games. GamerSky reported it on 7 September from photos shared by a member of the public; the exact location was not named.

title: "It Happens on PS5" global brand campaign featuring GTA VI
summary: Sony's worldwide PS5 campaign by adam&eve\TBWA first aired on 17 August and lists the release of GTA VI among the PS5 games it promotes. Sony described it as a 360-degree campaign across social, digital, outdoor, creator partnerships and live activations.

title: PlayStation Korea's "The Wait Is Over" GTA VI launch film
summary: Sony Interactive Entertainment Korea released a 60-second film in which Jay Park, chef Choi Kang-rok, caster Seong Seung-hon and members of QWER and LNGSHOT follow a blue light across Seoul that turns pink and leads each of them home to a PS5, before official GTA VI footage of Vice City. It went up on PlayStation Korea's YouTube channel on 11 November, ahead of the 19 November launch.

title: Limited edition GTA VI DualSense controllers
summary: Sony revealed Black and White GTA VI Limited Edition DualSense controllers with a colour-shifting finish and palm tree details, priced at £74.99, $84.99 and €84.99. Pre-orders opened on 10 September via PlayStation Direct and retailers, with launch from 19 November.

title: Custom GTA VI PS5 Pro consoles for Miami HEAT players
summary: Sony PlayStation and Rockstar Games gifted Miami HEAT players custom GTA VI PlayStation 5 Pro consoles, in black and in grey, with backlit teal-to-magenta panels and etched palm trees. Each comes in a Pelican-style briefcase with two matching DualSense controllers and the game. The consoles were made for the players and are not for sale; HEAT guard Davion Mitchell shared his on Instagram.

title: PlayStation Netherlands' 'Choose your own style' DualSense fashion posts
summary: PlayStation Netherlands ran 'Choose your own style', a social campaign in which game creators match their fashion looks to their favourite DualSense controller for the GTA VI launch. The Invaders was the agency.

title: PlayStation Flex adds GTA VI console lease bundles in the UK
summary: PlayStation's UK console leasing service, PlayStation Flex, now lists three GTA VI bundles, with prices starting at £18.49 a month. TheGamer reports the GTA VI bundles cannot be rolled monthly like standard leases: customers must choose a fixed 12, 24 or 36 month term.

title: PS5 Welcome hub GTA VI takeover and five backgrounds
summary: On launch day the PS5 Welcome hub took on a Vice City-style icon and a GTA VI promo panel, plus a new folder of five illustrated GTA VI backgrounds, most featuring Jason and Lucia. Push Square reported the takeover on 19 November.

title: Sony and Rockstar partnership: GTA VI "plays best on PS5"
summary: Sony said it worked closely with Rockstar so that GTA VI plays best on PS5, announcing this on 24 June ahead of PS Store pre-orders opening on 25 June. Bloomberg had reported a marketing deal whose terms were not disclosed, and Sony added a GTA VI home screen animation on PS5 and gave the PlayStation App icon Vice City colours.

title: PlayStation sells a 'GTA VI inspired' Sunset Shapes tee
summary: PlayStation Direct is selling the PlayStation Sunset Shapes Tee, a black T-shirt with the PlayStation shapes in a pink-to-purple gradient, described as "Grand Theft Auto VI inspired style", at $29.99. The store listed it as low stock and currently unavailable.

title: PlayStation and Xbox both claim record GTA VI pre-orders
summary: PlayStation posted on X on 10 November that Grand Theft Auto VI is the most pre-ordered game in PlayStation Store history, marking it with a video on why the game 'plays best on PS5' and urging players to clear storage and pre-load. The same day Xbox CEO Asha Sharma said it is the most pre-ordered game ever on the Xbox and Microsoft Store, and pointed to a new 10-year partnership with publisher Take-Two, without giving details.

title: RIMOWA and Rockstar make a one-off GTA VI PS5 case
summary: RIMOWA partnered with Rockstar Games on a special-edition case holding a custom PlayStation 5, its controllers and a copy of GTA VI. It is an exclusive Friends & Family edition and will not be sold to the public.

title: GTA VI album listening parties in 230-plus US record stores
location: Independent record stores across the US
summary: GTA BOOM reports that more than 230 US record stores, including Zia Records, Newbury Comics and Miami's Sweat Records and Technique Records, will play all 34 tracks of Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album on 18 November, a day before release. It says the events are billed as Global Listening Parties, tied to Rockstar's album partnership with Atlantic Records, and listed through a locator on the official album site. Many shops are reported to be giving out Leonida postcards, tote bags and slipmats to fans who pre-order; most events are free, some need an RSVP. Atlantic's official listening events site now lists parties on 18 November in the US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the UK, Germany, Poland, France, Spain, the Netherlands, Italy, South Korea and South Africa, with giveaways and an exclusive marble pink and blue vinyl to pre-order.

title: Key Largo's Caribbean Club styled as GTA VI's The Rusty Anchor bar
summary: Fan site GTA6VC reports that the Caribbean Club in Key Largo, Florida, has been made over as The Rusty Anchor, a bar from GTA VI's Key Lento. The report is based on photos shared by the GTAVI_Countdown account, crediting a Reddit user, showing a sign and merchandise bearing The Rusty Anchor name. Rockstar has not commented, so this is reported, not confirmed.

title: In-game QR codes open official FIB Seized pages
summary: QR codes inside Grand Theft Auto VI, scanned with a real phone, open Rockstar's short link rsg.ms/qr1, which redirects to official pages headed SEIZED at rockstargames.com/VI/seized/. The pages say the site has been seized by the Federal Investigation Bureau, in accordance with a warrant citing 47 U.S.C. § 11.25(A), and in partnership with the Vice City Police Department Cybercrime Division. They then joke that, due to a lack of federal funding, the FIB is selling ad space on seized IP addresses. The named offence changes between visits; nine variants were live when checked on 26 November 2026, including Hacking Crimes and Wire Fraud. The in-game phone does not open the pages. The bare /VI/seized URL returns a 404; each offence has its own path.

title: In-game brand posters and digital ads across Miami streets
summary: Posters and digital screens for fictional GTA VI brands such as Weazel News, Vault Nightclub, Coil and eCola were spotted around Miami, along with Vice City branding on buses and taxis and screens on boats. These are social media sightings that Rockstar has not confirmed.

title: NINE1NINE aerial banners over Miami Beach
summary: Planes towed banners over Miami Beach on 14 October advertising NINE1NINE, the game's parody of the E11EVEN nightclub, echoing a shot from the first trailer. Photos circulated online, but Rockstar has not claimed the flights and the operator is unknown.

title: Gran Vía banner and FNAC Callao windows in Madrid
location: Gran Vía and FNAC Callao, Madrid, Spain
summary: A banner covering a whole building front on Gran Vía shows Jason and Lucia on a Vice City beach, while FNAC Callao filled its windows with the cover and official artwork. Release-date posters also went up on main streets.

title: GTA VI takes about 300 m² of Fnac store fronts in Paris
location: Fnac Montparnasse and Fnac Ternes, Paris, France
summary: Ahead of launch, GTA VI bought outdoor ad space on the fronts of Fnac Montparnasse and Fnac Ternes in Paris, about 300 m² in total, through Fnac Darty's retail media arm Retailink.

title: GTA VI ad at Westfield Stratford City
summary: Fans posted photos on 4 November of a GTA VI advert on the footbridge from Stratford station to Westfield Stratford City. It is seen only in social posts so far, with no news report or official confirmation of the booking.

title: GTA VI ads spotted on a Brussels tram and Riyadh mall screens
summary: A compilation video posted on 14 November by fan account GTAVI_Countdown, built from fans' photos, shows GTA VI ads in new markets including a tram wrap in Brussels and digital screens in a Riyadh shopping mall, alongside billboards in Amsterdam and Zwolle. It is seen only in social posts so far, with no news report or official confirmation.

title: GTA VI banner goes up on Rockstar North's Edinburgh studio
location: Rockstar North, Holyrood Road, Edinburgh, UK
summary: A large banner of Jason and Lucia against a Vice City sunset now hangs above the entrance of Rockstar North's Holyrood Road studio in Edinburgh, the team behind the game. GameGPU says it was put up with lifting equipment from British company HighDrive, and fan account GTAVI_Countdown posted the finished banner on 15 November beside a 2018 photo of the Red Dead Redemption 2 banner in the same spot. Rockstar has not commented, and there is no mainstream coverage yet.

title: GTA VI billboard takeover in Toronto
location: Yonge and Dundas and Bloor-Yonge TTC station, Toronto, Canada
summary: Several large GTA VI billboards went up at Yonge and Dundas, with more GTA VI ads inside Bloor-Yonge subway station. A fan account counted three giant billboards at the junction.

title: GTA VI key art wraps the BFI IMAX in London
summary: A photo posted on 14 November by fan account GTAonlineNews shows Jason and Lucia key art and the GTA VI logo wrapped around the glass drum of the BFI IMAX cinema at Waterloo, with Ocean branding at the base. It is seen only in social posts so far, with no news report or official confirmation of the booking.

title: GTA VI outdoor ads spotted in around 15 cities worldwide
location: Barcelona, Edinburgh, Vienna, Berlin, Munich, Stockholm, Budapest, Melbourne, Brisbane, Sydney, Tokyo, Seoul, Mexico City, São Paulo and more
summary: Fans photographed GTA VI billboards and banners across Europe, Australia, Asia and Latin America, with reports counting around 15 cities. Outlets disagree on the full list (Warsaw and Miami each come from one report only) and Rockstar has not published where the ads run.

title: GTA VI outdoor artworks go up across Germany
location: Cologne, Munich, Berlin and Leipzig, Germany
summary: Large GTA VI artworks appeared on walls and scaffolding on Turiner Straße near Cologne Cathedral and at Munich's Karlsplatz, with a poster unfurled at Berlin's Park Inn on Alexanderplatz, an XXL poster on a Sparkasse building by Blissestraße station, an installation near Leipzig Hauptbahnhof and GTA-liveried sightseeing buses in Berlin. The report places them within Rockstar's worldwide campaign but does not name who booked each site.

title: GTA VI screens across London Waterloo station
summary: A fan video posted on 9 November by X user videotech shows GTA VI key art and the 19 November date across the large digital screen above the platforms at London Waterloo, carrying PlayStation branding. It is seen only in social posts so far, with no news report or official confirmation of the booking.

title: GTA VI wraps a King's Cross Underground tunnel
location: King's Cross St Pancras Underground station, London, UK
summary: Fan posts on X on 11 November show a passenger tunnel at King's Cross Underground station wrapped in pink and purple Grand Theft Auto VI artwork with the November 2026 release date. One poster wrote they never imagined "seeing king's cross wrapped in GTA 6 ads". No outlet or Rockstar post has reported it yet, so it is unconfirmed.

title: Rockstar surprise-releases a deluxe GTA VI album with 23 bonus tracks
summary: Four days after launch, Rockstar released a deluxe edition of Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album on streaming services, adding 23 bonus tracks to take it from 34 to 57 songs. Artists include Travis Scott, Slayyyter, The Dare, Denzel Curry, Offset and Overmono, who contribute five songs; Dork credits the release to Rockstar and Atlantic Records.

title: GTA VI trailer reported on the Piccadilly Circus screen
summary: Fan account @needlessrelic16 posted photos and 4K video on 16 November of GTA VI advertising on the Piccadilly Circus screen in London, shared widely by fan account @GTAVI_Countdown. Neither Rockstar nor a news outlet has confirmed who booked it, so it is unconfirmed.

title: 3,000 m² GTA VI visual on the Westfield CNIT, La Défense
location: Westfield CNIT, La Défense, Paris, France
summary: A 3,000 m² Jason and Lucia visual covers the glass front of the Westfield CNIT until early December, with Lucia's revolver left in, unlike the masked Bagnolet tower version. A separate 60 m² screen at Westfield Les 4 Temps runs until 22 November.

title: GTA VI takes over the screens at Westfield Centro Oberhausen
summary: GTA VI ads ran on several large digital screens inside Westfield Centro Oberhausen. Der Westen reported them on 18 November, ahead of launch. GamesWirtschaft had listed the mall among the new large-format sites in Germany a day earlier. Ocean Outdoor Germany, which operates the mall's large-format digital screens, commissioned Dilla.Media to photograph and film the installation for a cross-market Ocean highlight reel.

title: Rockstar releases the official GTA VI map as a free download, with a poster to follow
summary: With no paper map in the physical edition, Rockstar made the official GTA VI map a free download on its website on launch day, including a printable version and a large version of the cover art. A double-sided physical poster is due at the Rockstar Store shortly after launch.

title: Rockstar shares GTA VI clip that recreates its own Miami car stunt
summary: A clip posted by the Instagram account "Only in Dade" showed someone filming flashy cars on Ocean Drive, and fans questioned whether it was real footage or AI. Rockstar shared it on its Instagram stories, and IGN reports it recreates a real video from October, when Rockstar and West Coast Customs paraded GTA VI cars around Miami, down to the same passers-by. IGN calls it another viral marketing stunt, after Rockstar slipped gameplay into an episode of South Park.

title: Giant cover-art wrap on a Les Mercuriales tower
summary: A recreation of the GTA VI cover art was hung on one of the Les Mercuriales towers in Bagnolet, on the edge of Paris, in mid October. Two guns were edited out compared with the original artwork. Who commissioned and installed it has not been stated.

title: Jason and Lucia mural on Hollywood Boulevard
summary: A Jason and Lucia mural was reported on Hollywood Boulevard, with one site saying it was finished on 16 October at The Lofts at Hollywood & Vine. Neither Rockstar nor any primary source has confirmed it.

title: Rockstar opens a verified Douyin account to promote GTA VI in China
summary: Beebom, citing a 12 November GamerSky report, says Rockstar has joined Douyin, China's version of TikTok, with a verified account under the name 'ROCKSTAR INTERNATIONAL LIMITED'. Its first video, a vertical cut featuring Jason and Lucia, promotes the launch and pre-loading on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar has not announced an official mainland China release for GTA VI. TechNode also reported the account, adding that Rockstar posted the same clip on its Bilibili account.

title: Thank-you merch boxes sent to creators
summary: Rockstar sent boxes of GTA VI merch, including a pink canvas bag and stickers, to GTA content creators and at least one journalist as a thank-you ahead of launch.

title: Real-life GTA VI cars with Leonida plates tour Miami
summary: A convoy of customised cars styled as in-game models such as the Coquette, Cheetah and Tempesta, plus a Lamborghini in Vice Beach Police livery, was filmed in Miami around 15 and 16 October with Leonida plates. Rockstar has not commented; some reports credit West Coast Customs, but this is unconfirmed.

brand: Rockstar Games / City of Miami Beach
title: "Vice Beach" sign at Lummus Park and a pink Muscle Beach
location: Lummus Park, Ocean Drive, Miami Beach, USA
summary: City documents plan a "Vice Beach" sign about 34 feet wide in Lummus Park and a pink repaint of Muscle Beach, live from 1 November to mid-January under Rockstar's Miami Beach deal. A fan account reported the sign installed on 4 November, but no news outlet has confirmed it is up. GTAVice's reading of the Miami Beach agreement names Amplify Marketing as Rockstar's agent.

title: W South Beach to become Vice City's "Y Hotel"
location: W South Beach, 2201 Collins Ave, Miami Beach, USA
summary: City of Miami Beach documents show a $650,000 deal, signed on 16 and 19 October, between Rockstar's agency Amplify Marketing and the hotel's owner to dress the W as the in-game Y Hotel, with a large banner and a "Y" sculpture replacing the "W" from mid-October to 31 December. Each element needs city approval, and no photos of it installed have been reported yet.

title: GTA VI takes over the Ziggo Dome screen and Mall of the Netherlands
location: Netherlands (Amsterdam Ziggo Dome, motorways, Westfield Mall of the Netherlands)
summary: Rockstar's GTA VI ads went up across the Netherlands from 9 November via Ocean Outdoor, including motorway billboards and the Ziggo Dome screen until 29 November. A two-week Westfield Mall of the Netherlands takeover with every Ocean digital screen in the mall starts on 16 November.

title: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival in Miami
source_name: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival (official site)
summary: Rockstar and PlayStation staged a one-day music festival at Mana Wynwood in Miami's Wynwood neighbourhood on 21 November, two days after launch. Thousands of fans attended an immersive Vice City experience with customised sports cars and themed food from Taco Bomb and Burger Shot. Ca7riel & Paco Amoroso opened, Cardi B closed her set with "Don't Chart" from GTA VI: The Album and offered to give 10 people in the crowd a copy of the game, and Travis Scott's Cactus Jack finale brought out Don Toliver, Sheck Wes and Sexyy Red. Metro Boomin, Justice, Kodak Black, Tainy and Rauw Alejandro also performed, with Rauw arriving on stage in a car after a simulated in-game police chase. An on-site store sold GTA VI gear.

title: Official GTA VI merchandise collection
summary: Rockstar opened a GTA VI apparel and accessories range on its online store, priced from $4.99 sticker sets up to $39.99 for a canvas tote and a Vice City Zippo lighter.

title: Stadium ads at Milan derby and Stade de France
summary: Pitchside LED boards at AC Milan v Inter on 31 October and a large banner at Stade de France on 30 October were reported. No primary source or official confirmation was found.

title: GTA VI pop-up opens at Selfridges London, with a £1m Grotti Cheetah
summary: The Grand Theft Auto VI experience at Selfridges on Oxford Street opened on 9 November as a merchandise pop-up. Video Games Chronicle reports more than 60 items for sale; GTA BOOM reports prices from around £5 to a £2,500 jacket. Its centrepiece is a real Grotti Cheetah, a customised Ferrari Testarossa that Rockstar built with West Coast Customs and flew in from Miami, which Selfridges lists for sale at £1 million through its Personal Shopping service. Reports say the pop-up runs until 28 November and that some lines sold out quickly; those details are reported, not confirmed by Selfridges. First announced by Selfridges on Instagram on 5 November after a Vice City scene in its Christmas windows. On 12 November Video Games Chronicle reported that photos of a stylised GTA VI map, apparently from the Collector's Edition set on display at Selfridges, had leaked online; a post said the set was also on show at Selfridges in Manchester's Exchange Square. The Collector's Edition is not sold at Selfridges.

title: Skyviews wheel lit in Vice City colours and Pier 5 renamed "Pier VI"
summary: The Bayside observation wheel was reported lit in the game's pink-to-purple colours, with Pier 5 relabelled "Pier VI" in neon and a jet ski in game livery on display. No primary source or official confirmation was found.

title: South Park episode airs new GTA VI gameplay
summary: The South Park episode "Guinea Pig on a Stick" showed a short clip of GTA VI gameplay, with Jason on a Vice City beach in a dog mess gag. Outlets report the credits thank Rockstar, but no formal partnership has been announced. South Park's season 29 finale, which aired this week, leaned on GTA VI again: a power cut leaves South America unable to play the newly released game, with one resident warning that losing power mid-mission means losing everything, before the story turns out billionaires are diverting the town's electricity to AI data centres.

title: Spotify opens a dedicated GTA VI editorial world in 33 markets
summary: On 20 November 2026, from 9am ET, Spotify opened a dedicated Grand Theft Auto VI editorial world in the Spotify app in 33 markets. The destination gathers the official soundtrack playlist, in-game radio-station playlists and 25 years of GTA music, including a GTA Series Museum and classic stations.

title: Official GTA VI playlist and album pre-save on Spotify
summary: On 17 September Spotify posted the official Grand Theft Auto VI playlist, featuring new music from Travis Scott, Morgan Wallen, Rauw Alejandro and others. The post asked fans to stream it and pre-save Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album on Spotify.

title: Spotify-branded GTA VI billboards in three US cities
location: New York, Los Angeles, Miami, USA
summary: Billboards combining GTA VI artist artwork with the Spotify logo went up in Los Angeles, New York and Miami on 16 September, the day after several musicians posted the art. Spotify's X account shared photos with an eyes emoji. The billboards themselves are confirmed by Spotify's own post, but no formal deal between Spotify and Rockstar has been announced.

title: The Weather Channel forecasts Leonida's weather with Rockstar screenshots
summary: The Weather Channel posted six new GTA VI screenshots of weather around Leonida, saying Rockstar gave it an exclusive look at the forecast. Rockstar's Owen Shepherd said the team had to completely reimagine the in-game weather systems, which are designed to be as unpredictable as Florida's.

title: Tove Lo releases 'Blood In Your Eyes' from GTA VI: The Album
summary: Tove Lo released 'Blood In Your Eyes', the latest single from Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, on 10 November. NME reports the track also features on a new GTA VI video announcing that pre-loads are live. The album of 34 original tracks is due on 20 November, the day after the game, and eight songs from it had already been released.

title: Pißwasser, Patriot and No Mames Vice City beers go on sale
summary: After its labels were approved in the US TTB database, Doral brewer Tripping Animals put Pißwasser, Patriot and No Mames Vice City on sale at its taproom and selected Miami venues in late October, with empty cans reselling on eBay for $150 to $200 a set. Neither Rockstar nor the brewery has confirmed an official licence.

title: Walmart pre-orders to come with a "surprise"
summary: Walmart's GTA VI listing said pre-orders would include a "surprise" with delivery, photographed by deals account Nintendeal before the text was apparently edited. The contents are unknown and Walmart has not confirmed it.

title: Weekly Famitsu puts GTA VI on its cover with a 32-page special
summary: Weekly Famitsu announced on X that GTA VI is the cover of its issue No. 1972, on sale 19 November, with Jason and Lucia art from the Extended Look. The issue carries a 32-page feature on the game and a look back at the history of Rockstar Games, and stays on sale until 3 December.

title: Wynwood Walls x Rockstar: new murals, free local entry and "The Art of Vice City" merch
summary: Wynwood Walls announced a partnership with Rockstar covering new murals by artists featured in GTA VI (reported as ten, on view until 1 January 2027), free entry for Miami-Dade residents until 2028, and "The Art of Vice City" merch on pre-order with artists including Tristan Eaton, D*Face, FAILE and Queen Andrea.

title: GTA VI comes to Xbox Cloud Gaming, including on Xbox One
summary: Xbox announced that owners of GTA VI can stream it through Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One from 1am ET on 19 November, the only way to play it on Xbox One. The game must be bought separately and is not in Game Pass, and at launch it will not stream to PC, phones, TVs or browsers.

title: YouTube reports 3.5bn+ global views of GTAVI videos on release day
summary: On 24 November 2026, YouTube's official X account posted that GTAVI fans around the world pulled up and showed out on YouTube. The post's graphic said there were 3.5bn+ global views of GTAVI videos on release day, and that there were over 3.5 billion global views of videos with GTAVI in the title the day of the US release (19 November 2026), including variations of GTAVI keywords.

title: YouTube and Rockstar partner on GTA VI launch, with a 24-hour livestream
location: Global, with live coverage from Miami
summary: YouTube announced on 12 November that it is partnering with Rockstar Games for the GTA VI launch. It is adding five limited-edition GTA VI gifts to YouTube Live, including Wanted Stars, a 'Visit Vice City' Shorts effect, and the official soundtrack on the YouTube Music homepage through launch week. A 24-hour stream on youtube.com/youtube starts at midnight ET on 19 November with creators including Caylus, Jelly and Jake Baldino, after an RDCWorld pre-show from 11pm ET on 18 November, and ends with live coverage from Miami. YouTube says the GTA series has passed 900 billion views on the platform, with GTA VI pre-launch videos above 40 billion.

title: A&W Malaysia posts burgers on a bonnet while waiting for GTA 6
summary: A&W Malaysia posted GTA-style characters sitting on a car bonnet outside an A&W restaurant eating burgers, captioned 'GTA 6 got us waiting. A&W got us eating.'

title: adidas Samba OG "Miami" borrows the Vice City palette
summary: GQ UK reports that adidas is releasing the Samba OG "Miami" on 5 December 2026, in icy blue with embossed palm fronds, pink details, a 305 area-code reference on the tongue and a tropical cityscape insole. GQ says it is not an official collaboration with Rockstar Games or Inter Miami, but looks like Vice City's colour palette. It goes on sale at Foot Locker and adidas, with an in-store release in Miami during Art Basel.

title: Allianz Direct sends Dackel Dieter into a 'Große Tarif Aktion' open-world game
summary: Allianz Direct's car insurance campaign 'Große Tarif Aktion' (GTA) casts its mascot Dackel Dieter as the hero of an open-world game, with the line 'Chaos gehört ins Game, deine Sicherheit zu Allianz Direct'. It has three films, 45 stills, display ads, a streamer partnership and a landing page, running from 19 November on Twitch, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube. Hamburg agency TankTank made it. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Amazon Now offers 30-minute GTA VI delivery in three UK cities
summary: On launch day Amazon Now made GTA VI available for 30-minute delivery in London, Manchester and Birmingham, according to a LinkedIn post by Amazon Now's EU senior manager Elisa Michelin Salomon. No price or conditions were given.

title: American Heart Association: book your check-up on your GTA sick day
summary: The American Heart Association posted: "If you're calling in sick to play GTA VI, you need to schedule your annual visit."

title: Amul calls TriCone the 'Rockstars of Chill'
summary: Amul called its TriCone ice creams the 'Rockstars of Chill' in a GTA launch topical, one of several Indian brands including Haldiram's, Subway, Bikaji and Red Label that CNBC TV18 said went full Vice City.

title: Shrek 2 Remastered announced with a GTA VI-style trailer
summary: Aspyr revealed DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered at the ID@Xbox Showcase with a trailer that parodies GTA VI's trailer style. The game came out on 10 November, nine days before GTA VI.

title: Atlanta Police: 'Keep it in the game'
summary: Atlanta Police posted "GTA is not a real place, but Atlanta is!", warning that reckless driving, auto theft and violence have real consequences: "Keep it in the game. Don't bring it to our streets."

title: AXE 'Vice City' post confuses fans
source_name: J'ai un pote dans la com
summary: AXE showed its deodorant bottles as collectibles in a poolside villa in GTA VI artwork style, and its use of 'Vice' and 'City' left some fans asking if it was an official tie-in.

title: Axe puts its product on a Vice City-style billboard
summary: Axe shared an image of a billboard for its product set against the game's city, captioned 'Not available in the game, but you can get yours in real life.'

title: Azucar Ice Cream makes a 'Coconut 305' flavour for GTA VI
location: Calle Ocho, Little Havana, Miami, USA
summary: Little Havana parlour Azucar Ice Cream has a limited-edition 'Coconut 305' flavour inspired by the excitement around the game's launch.

title: B&Q defaces its own billboard with "for lucia"
summary: LBB reports that B&Q ran an outdoor billboard from Leo UK with its heritage tagline spray-painted with "for lucia", a nod to Jason fixing up the house for Lucia in the game. It was shared on B&Q's Instagram with a caption asking followers to explain the vandalism, and the creative uses models with power drills and paint cans in a loading-screen style. LBB says it was a hit in the comments.

title: HR platform publishes GTA 6 PTO spike data
summary: The HR software firm released data showing time-off requests for 19 November running 13% above equivalent days in 2024 and 2025, plus a survey saying 18% of salaried US workers planned to take the day off.

title: Banco do Brasil hosts a launch-night livestream with influencers
summary: Banco do Brasil ran a livestream through the night of 18 November into launch day, with influencers running activations and special offers for the online audience. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Russian firm gives staff GTA VI release day off
summary: Benza, a maker of fuel station equipment, says staff who are GTA VI fans can take 19 November off if they show they have the game, for example a console that runs it. Founder Mikhail Kolesnikov told Telegram channel Ostorozhno Novosti; Meduza puts the workforce at about 240.

title: IGN and Best Buy run three weeks of GTA VI giveaways
summary: IGN and Best Buy ran weekday giveaways on IGN Rewards from 26 October to 13 November, building to themed Friday bundles, then an in-store event in Torrance, California on 14 November.

title: Esports team gives all staff GTA VI release day off
summary: BetBoom Team, an esports organisation, says all employees get a day off on 19 November, the GTA VI release day. CEO Artem Savelyev announced it in his personal Telegram channel, as reported by Esports.ru; no conditions are stated.

title: Big Americans names launch day 'Ultimate Game Day' and gives away pizza kits
summary: Big Americans renamed 19 November 'Ultimate Game Day' on its socials and ran a Radio 538 giveaway of pizza gaming packages with a PS5, the game and its new Filled Crust pizzas. The Invaders was the agency. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Big Brand Tire gives away free wheel locks on GTA VI launch day
summary: Big Brand Tire & Service and its family of brands, including Belle Tire and Tire World, offered free locking lug nuts with a qualifying wheel purchase on 19 November, worth up to $200,000 in total. CEO Joe Buscaglia said the aim was to make sure the only thing stolen that day was virtual. The release was issued on 16 November.

title: Bitget CEO trades a day off for an in-game crypto screenshot
summary: Asked on X whether a staff member could take launch day off, Bitget CEO Gracy Chen said yes if they found a crypto reference in GTA VI and sent a screenshot. She then opened it to anyone replying, promising digital copies of the game to 10 people she picks. Bitget has no deal with Rockstar.

title: Blinkit delivers GTA VI in 11 Indian cities
location: India (Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad and seven more cities)
summary: Quick-commerce app Blinkit is selling GTA VI in select areas of 11 Indian cities, delivering a collectible box with a digital download code rather than a disc. Chief executive Albinder Dhindsa predicted a "suspicious number of sick leaves" around launch.

title: BMW posts a Vice City-style convertible
source_name: J'ai un pote dans la com
summary: BMW posted a classic convertible in GTA VI-style artwork as part of a wave of brand trendjacking.

title: BMW M posts an electric M3 prototype drifting in a GTA-style film
summary: BMW M posted an electric M3 prototype drifting, pointing players to episode 8 of BMW M Electrified on YouTube, according to Autoblog.it. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: boAt gives staff an optional day off: "Out of office. Into Vice City"
summary: Indian audio brand boAt posted a notice giving employees an optional day off on 19 November for the GTA VI launch, captioned "Out of office. Into Vice City". Reports differ on whether the day is paid.

title: Bolt's 'Grand Trip Away' competition sends a gamer's partner on a launch-weekend trip
summary: Bolt, the European ride-hailing and food delivery platform, launched 'Grand Trip Away', a week-long search for the partners of gamers hit hardest by the GTA VI launch on 19 November. One winner and a friend get a getaway worth 1,500 euros: two return flights within Europe, two hotel nights and 150 euros of Bolt Rewards, to a city of their choice from 34. Entries are made at grandtripaway.com by describing how much the launch will hijack their weekend.

title: Miami club Booby Trap announces a Cardi B GTA VI takeover
summary: Booby Trap On The River hosted a GTA VI takeover on launch night, Thursday 19 November. Cardi B hosted a pink-carpet event and performed, including "Don't Chart" from GTA VI: The Album. Travis Scott later hosted an official after-party at the same venue following the GTA VI festival on 21 November. There is no sign Rockstar is involved.

title: BT says GTA VI pre-downloads caused its second-biggest traffic peak
summary: BT said GTA VI pre-downloads produced the second-biggest broadband traffic peak on its network on record, behind the Arsenal v Atletico Madrid Champions League stream in May 2026, and that demand could climb higher at launch on 19 November. The Telegraph reported BT and other providers had added network capacity ahead of the release. On launch day BT updated that GTA VI downloads drove the biggest broadband traffic peak ever recorded across BT and EE home broadband. Fort Augustus, on Loch Ness, had the UK's biggest percentage uplift in gaming download traffic. New EE research found over half of British gamers would rather spend an evening on GTA VI than on a date.

title: Budgy Smuggler's sales rep plays GTA missions on the Manly Corso
summary: Budgy Smuggler posted a series of GTA-themed social videos on launch day starring its customs and wholesale sales rep Harry Forsyth. In one he walks out of the store in Budgy Smugglers, hijacks a bicycle on the Manly Corso, takes cash from an ATM and spends it on Budgy Smuggler gear, ending on a GTA-style 'Mission Passed' screen.

title: Burger King Belgium makes the 'HeartWhopper', a real seven-patty Heart Stopper
summary: Burger King Belgium turned Burger Shot's Heart Stopper into a real burger, the HeartWhopper, with seven beef patties, saying it is "taking back what they're owed". It is not on the menu: fans win one through a two-week social media competition by sharing a clip of themselves eating a burger from the in-game restaurant, with Burger King Belgium picking a favourite each day.

title: Burger King France asks players to go easy on Burger Shot's staff
summary: Burger King France showed the emblem of Burger Shot, the game's parody burger chain, with a request to players: 'Allez-y doucement avec nos équipiers là-bas svp' (go easy on our crew over there, please). There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Burger King New Zealand nods to GTA VI's launch on social media
summary: Burger King New Zealand posted a Vice City-styled social item cheekily nodding to GTA VI's launch day, as reported by Creative Review.

title: Burger King Spain reimagines itself in Vice City
source_name: J'ai un pote dans la com
summary: Burger King España showed its signature burger in GTA VI art style, a nod to the in-game Burger Shot. A commenter quoted by Creative Bloq called the brand a parasite.

title: Car tuning firm pauses operations for GTA 6 launch day
summary: The US car tuning parts maker posted a memo announcing a company-wide pause on 19 November because many staff had asked for the day off. Push Square and Gfinity reported it as a real closure, but GTA Intel later reported the company said it was a joke and was not actually shutting down; we could not see the company's own statement.

title: BYD Auto Europe restyles the GTA cover as 'Build Your Dreams'
summary: BYD Auto Europe posted its own version of the classic GTA cover art with 'Build Your Dreams', saying that with everyone at home playing on launch night, it was the time to get out on the real roads. There is no Rockstar deal.

brand: Call of Duty: Warzone, Fall Guys, Halo Infinite
title: Rival games copy GTA 6 teaser artwork style
summary: After Rockstar's trailer announcement image, several rival game accounts recreated the GTA 6 announcement style for their own updates.

title: Canal+ promotes The Office PL season six with GTA-style artwork
summary: Wirtualnemedia.pl reports that Canal+ commissioned illustrator Kuba Kwiatkowski to make a GTA-style artwork promoting the sixth season of The Office PL. Filip Połoska of creative group Nowy Ład singled it out as the stand-out Polish piece.

title: 'Run Away With Me' streams jump 288%
summary: On 21 Nov, per Rolling Stone, citing Luminate.

title: Caviar's gold GTA VI 'Ocean Drive' Galaxy Z Fold 8
summary: Luxury customisation brand Caviar released an Ocean Drive edition of the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 series to mark the launch. It has geometric Art Deco patterns over two layers of 24K gold plating and a six-star wanted level on the back. Android Authority reports prices from $11,130 for the Fold 8 and $11,560 for the Fold 8 Ultra. It is a third-party customisation, not a Rockstar or Samsung deal.

title: Ceres puts 'bad advice' billboards up in Milan, 'but only in V. City'
summary: Ceres put up giant billboards for two weeks in Milan, at Garibaldi and the Navigli, with 'bad advice' lines such as 'Prendi la strada sbagliata', 'Fai pessime scelte' and 'Vivi senza limiti', each followed by 'Ma solo a V. City, eh'. We Are Social handled strategy, concept and creative, with Laura Venuti as creative director, and creator content ran alongside. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Cheil's Sidemission.nl lets fans play through video calls
summary: Agency Cheil built Sidemission.nl for fans who could not take the day off: you enter your name, the site listens in on your video call, alerts you when a colleague says your name and writes the answer you should give. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: ChipsMore! sells '18 Unrestricted' cookies to gamers too young for GTA VI
summary: ChipsMore! Malaysia and Leo Indonesia have created '18 Unrestricted', a limited-edition cookie pack reserved for gamers too young to play GTA VI. A QR code behind the label unlocks a private Discord with tips for games such as Mobile Legends: Bang Bang, PUBG Mobile and EA FC, and the packs are sold at Lotus from booths where bouncers check MyKad ID. The brand is also sending kits to gaming streamers to pass to their younger siblings.

title: Chorus: GTA VI sets New Zealand's broadband record
summary: Chorus said traffic on its network hit a record 5.6Tbps at 9.30pm the night before launch as New Zealanders downloaded GTA VI, beating the 5.4Tbps Fortnite record. Daily use reached 34.7PB.

title: Citroën contrasts its 2013 2CV with its 2026 2CV-named concept
summary: Citroën posted its 2CV in 2013 against its 2CV-named concept in 2026, according to Autoblog.it. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: The real Ocean View Hotel throws a GTA VI launch party
location: Clevelander South Beach, 1020 Ocean Drive, Miami Beach, USA
summary: The Clevelander South Beach, the Ocean Drive hotel that inspired GTA VI's Ocean View Hotel, is hosting a "Welcome to Vice City" launch party on 19 November from 5pm to 10pm. It promises giveaways, merch, a raffle for a copy of the game, "Vice Frozen Margaritas", three beers featured in the game for a limited time and the soundtrack playing all day. The hotel calls itself an official launch partner, but GTA BOOM notes Rockstar has not confirmed that.

title: Miami's Club Space becomes GTA VI's The Vault for a launch weekend
summary: Club Space teased a transformation into The Vault, the Vice City nightclub, for a three-night celebration on 20 to 22 November, with Chris Lorenzo listed for the Friday. Circoloco Records, the label Circoloco launched with Rockstar in 2021, shared the announcement on Instagram with the line 'The future in Vice City is unpredictable'. CULTR reports Justice may play but says that is not fully confirmed. Beebom notes the event is not part of Rockstar's official promotion.

title: London chicken shop copying GTA's Cluckin' Bell renames
summary: A London takeaway using a near copy of GTA's Cluckin' Bell logo, briefly taken for GTA 6 marketing, changed its sign to 'The Cluckin' B' and its company name to The Cluckin Bite Ltd. Coverage suggests Take-Two stepped in, but that is inference; Take-Two and Rockstar did not comment.

title: Clutch: 'GTA in the GTA' puts the game's cars on Toronto streets
summary: Canadian online car retailer Clutch and agency Courage renamed cars on its website with their in-game names at clutch.ca/gta. It also wrapped a Lamborghini and a Corvette as replicas of the game's cars and toured them around Toronto on a Clutch truck. The pitch plays on GTA standing for the Greater Toronto Area.

title: Comcast says GTA VI drove the biggest traffic day in its history
summary: Comcast published a story saying GTA VI drove the biggest internet traffic day in its network's history and accounts for five of its 10 busiest days ever. It gave no traffic volumes; Comcast separately told esports.gg Xfinity traffic jumped 4x when the game unlocked in New Zealand.

title: Comic Con India hosts GTA VI launch-day play sessions
location: Saket Social, Delhi and Vashi Social, Navi Mumbai, India
summary: Comic Con India, part of Nodwin Gaming, is holding GTA VI launch-day gatherings from 2pm to 6pm at two venues, where fans can play without buying the game or owning a console.

title: Conor McGregor gives his '400 strong' workforce the day off
summary: Former UFC champion Conor McGregor announced on social media that his 'entire workforce team, 400 strong across countries and continents' has launch day off: 'Enjoy the game!' He did not name the businesses involved.

title: Coopérative U pitches Expresso Lungo capsules for long nights of play
summary: Coopérative U promoted its Expresso Lungo coffee capsules (Max Havelaar) for the long nights of play after launch. Sylvain Ferry, deputy managing director, posted it on LinkedIn, according to RMC. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Corendon's 'Side Quest: Miami' ad sends players on a real Vice City trip
summary: Corendon posted a GTA-style Instagram ad, 'Side Quest: Miami', with a mission list: check in with Corendon, fly to Miami, pick up a Mustang and explore. The tour operator recently opened two hotels in Miami Beach. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Coxinhas Bady launches a GTA-style mini coxinha sharing combo
summary: Coxinha chain Coxinhas Bady, in north-west São Paulo state, created a combo of mini coxinhas and a soft drink to share, promoted in the game's style. It says nearly 10% of its social views and shares came from this content. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Coyo Taco and Grails add GTA VI menus in Miami
summary: WSVN's Deco Drive reports Coyo Taco is serving a 'Vice City taco' of carne asada in a neon pink tortilla with a black cherry frozen margarita, and Grails Miami sports bar is decorated in GTA colours with game-inspired sneaker-shaped mugs to take home. Pier 5 at Bayside Marketplace also has a Vice City-inspired cocktail. No Rockstar involvement is mentioned.

title: Cardiff agency CREO closes for a paid GTA VI day off
