summary: Cardiff creative agency CREO is giving its whole team a paid day off on Friday 20 November for the GTA VI release, with no annual leave needed, while its three owners keep working. It is releasing a short film of its empty studio ending on the line 'CREO IS CLOSED. VICE CITY IS OPEN.'

title: Cyberpunk reminds fans of its own delays
summary: The Cyberpunk 2077 account recalled its own old 'no more delays' promise in response to the GTA 6 delay.

title: Dakauz declares a company holiday for GTA VI
summary: Dakauz posted its own GTA VI company-holiday notice for launch day, captioned: "Just a day off for a game we've waited years for." Gulf News listed it among companies declaring a holiday for 19 November.

title: IGN and Dave & Buster's host a two-night Game with IGN event in Irvine
summary: IGN and Dave & Buster's hosted a two-night Game with IGN event at Dave & Buster's in Irvine, California, on 20 and 21 November, from 6pm to midnight PST. IGN's own LinkedIn post advertised themed drinks, arcade action, head-to-head competitions and prize giveaways including a PlayStation 5, with pre-loaded Power Cards for the first 100 guests. IGN's event page, linked from that post, also offered hands-on access to 'the game the world has been waiting for', the weekend after GTA VI launched. No Rockstar deal is mentioned.

title: DE-CIX says GTA VI set a global internet exchange traffic record
summary: Internet exchange operator DE-CIX said traffic hit a record 33.03 Tbps across its exchanges at 20:20 CET on 18 November as GTA VI's launch began, about 25% above a typical week early in the year. Frankfurt reached 22.15 Tbps, just under the 22.30 Tbps record it set when pre-downloads opened on 10 November.

title: French neobank refunds GTA 6 for new customers
summary: Lille-based neobank Deblock refunds up to €79.99 of a GTA 6 purchase for new customers who open an account between 20 October and 31 December 2026, use the code PAYDAY and spend €1,000 on its card within 90 days.

title: Delhi Metro: 'Grand Theft Auto 6: Delhi Metro Edition'
summary: Delhi Metro Rail Corporation posted on X: 'Vice City has its vibe, but Delhi has its Metro. Grand Theft Auto 6: Delhi Metro Edition.' CNBC TV18 reported it among Indian government and brand posts borrowing the game's look at launch.

title: Deliveroo wishes everyone a happy 19 November in the game's typeface
summary: The day before launch Deliveroo posted a delivery bag in a living room bathed in Vice City evening light with 'Joyeux 19 novembre à tous' in the game's typeface, and a caption about leave booked, controller charged and dinner ordered. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Denver Police: running from police is still illegal
summary: Denver police reminded GTA VI fans that "running from police is still illegal".

title: GTA-style chase video on TikTok
summary: Derbyshire Police posted real chase footage edited with a GTA-style HUD and five-star wanted level, captioned that the driver could have waited a few weeks for GTA 6 and will now spend release day in prison. He was jailed for 14 months for dangerous driving and other offences.

title: Deutsche Telekom joins GTA VI art trend
summary: Deutsche Telekom's GTA VI-style post was embedded in Creative Bloq's round-up of brand trendjacking, which questioned how a mobile network fits the trend.

title: Devolver moves a game to GTA 6 day and offers to publish it
summary: Devolver Digital moved one of its games to 19 November 2026, the new GTA 6 date, and asked Rockstar if it needed a publisher to get back on track. Atari also replied offering to co-publish.

title: Devolver offers a free game to fans who delete their GTA VI preload
summary: Devolver offered a chance to win a Steam key for its PC platformer Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed, also out on 19 November, to anyone who posts a video of themselves deleting their GTA VI preload with #MakeRoomForVolvy. No outlet says how many keys are on offer.

title: DHL Express casts its rider in a GTA-style delivery mission
summary: DHL Express posted a reel of one of its riders delivering a package through a game-like city, captioned 'Preparing for an international spike in deliveries on GTA release day like...'

title: Discord: 'We got an official Rockstar server before GTA 6'
summary: Discord joked about the long wait using the 'before GTA 6' meme after Rockstar launched its official Discord server.

title: DJI builds its own GTA-style 'Sky city'
summary: DJI posted AI-generated visuals of its devices in a game-style open world it called 'Sky city', with four characters (a photographer, stunt driver, observer and rookie) for followers to pick for a first mission. The post said the visuals were AI-generated.

title: Domino's tells Rockstar to deliver GTA 6 on time
summary: A Facebook post announcing a new product joked that Domino's had delivered, so now it was Rockstar's turn to deliver GTA 6 on time, prompting fans to speculate about a tie-in.

title: Domino's UK offers help after GTA 6 delay
summary: Replying to Rockstar's delay announcement, Domino's UK told Rockstar to call if it needed help delivering. The account has made earlier GTA 6 jokes on X.

title: DoorDash: Miami late-night orders up nearly 25% on GTA VI launch night
summary: DoorDash said late-night orders in Miami rose nearly 25% on GTA VI launch night, the biggest jump of any market it tracked, and searches for GTA VI on its app climbed more than 940% in the run-up. Against a typical Wednesday night, orders for controllers and gaming accessories rose 450%, HDMI cables 440% and headsets 70%, with energy drinks up more than 20%.

title: DoorDash's 'CAKEGTA6' Cheesecake Factory code
summary: DoorDash offered $6 off Cheesecake Factory orders of $20 or more with the code CAKEGTA6, on launch day only.

title: "Game Series" VI beer timed to the GTA VI launch
summary: Russian beer brand Dr.Diesel is reported to be releasing a limited "Game Series" can (5%, 0.43 L) with a Roman "VI" and the slogan "Vice Vibes & Energy", due in Russian shops in mid-November. The can does not name GTA or Rockstar and there is no Rockstar deal; no statement from the brand itself was found.

title: Durex India worries GTA VI will mean less action in the bedroom
summary: Durex India marked the GTA VI launch with an Instagram post joking that the game could mean less action in the bedroom. It is a brand reaction, not a Rockstar partnership.

title: Energy drink Dzik says its planned post made way for gaming
summary: Wirtualnemedia.pl reports that Polish energy drink brand Dzik posted a handwritten-style note pinned to a board saying its scheduled post had made way for playing. The joke also reminded followers of its drinks, shown on a graphic in tropical colours.

title: E11EVEN becomes NINE1NINE for one night
summary: The Miami nightclub that GTA VI's NINE1NINE parodies is rebranding as "NINE1NINE Vice City" for one night, with Flo Rida headlining. It is the club's own promotion, not a Rockstar event.

title: Madden NFL 27 begs players not to delete it to make room for GTA 6
summary: With GTA VI taking 212GB on PS5, EA Sports added a GTA-style message inside Madden NFL 27: "Don't delete! The crew is assembling for a high-stakes run. Await the signal from our insider on 11/17. Do not leak this transmission!" Push Square reports it teases a content update due on 17 November, two days before GTA VI launches. EA also posted earlier in the week: "Don't let 210GB get between you and Your League."

title: Russian developer gives a paid day off to staff who bought GTA VI
summary: EDINO Group, a Russian construction and development holding, is giving an extra paid day off on 19 November by order of the CEO, but only to employees who bought an official copy for PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X|S. Staff had to email proof of purchase by 17:00 on 18 November. Client viewings and meetings stayed scheduled. Posted by the company on vc.ru.

title: Canadian firm Edison Motors to shut for two days for GTA 6
summary: Edison Motors told staff it would suspend operations on 19 and 20 November 2026, citing leave requests and saying some employees would be doing important research in Vice City. Reported by iXBT Games; we could not find the company's own post.

title: Einstein Bros. sells a $5 'All-Nighter' sandwich for the morning after
summary: Einstein Bros. Bagels is offering a $5 All-Nighter Egg Sandwich to rewards members on 20 November only, the morning after the GTA VI launch. People who join the programme on 19 November can redeem it.

title: El Pollo Loco runs a 'stay in' GTA VI delivery deal
summary: The chicken chain is promoting a 'stay in' deal for the GTA VI launch: free delivery on 19 November and 25% off all weekend for Loco Rewards members.

title: El Sótano recasts the GTA VI cover with writers and Bellas Artes
summary: Mexican bookshop chain El Sótano recreated the game's cover with writers in the panels and the Palacio de Bellas Artes behind them. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Elgato and Twitch launch a console Streaming Kit pitched at GTA VI
summary: Twitch and Elgato, which is owned by Corsair, announced the Elgato X Twitch Streaming Kit, pairing the Elgato Game Capture 4K X with a Corsair MP600 Elite PS5 SSD, with 10 per cent off for Twitch partners and affiliates. GamesRadar frames it as aimed at PC creators moving to console for GTA VI, which has no PC version. The 1TB bundle costs $554.98, or $499.99 with the Twitch discount; the 2TB version costs $694.98.

title: Emirates: 'You're taking leave tomorrow to fly somewhere... right?'
summary: Emirates marked the eve of launch with "Here we go again. You're taking leave tomorrow to fly somewhere... right?", listed by Mashable among brand reactions to GTA VI.

title: Employment Hero data shows Australian leave bookings for launch day up 29%
summary: Employment platform Employment Hero says annual leave bookings for Thursday 19 November are up 29% on the comparable day last year, across a fixed sample of 870,275 Australian employees. Among men aged 18 to 44 bookings are up 84%. The figures are bookings made at least nine days out, not absences.

title: eSky: Miami flight searches up 215% ahead of GTA VI
location: Poland, Romania, Bulgaria and Latin America
summary: Travel agency eSky Group said searches for flights from Poland to Miami rose 215% year on year from 21 September to 15 November, with Miami package searches up 545% in Romania and 500% in Bulgaria.

title: Australian workplace regulator uses GTA 6 to explain unpaid leave
summary: The government workplace watchdog posted a tongue-in-cheek Instagram carousel using GTA 6 artwork to explain unpaid leave options for workers who want launch day off, concluding it comes down to the employer agreeing. In a second GTA 6 post, reported on 9 November, it reminded workers that sick leave around 19 November is only for genuine illness or injury and that employers can ask for evidence.

title: Fairwood tells gamers to pre-order meals on its app
summary: Hong Kong fast-food chain Fairwood posted a same-day GTA VI launch post urging players to pre-order meals on the Fairwood App. Marketing director Adwin Lau called it lighthearted newsjacking rather than a hard sell.

title: The French golf federation films a round with a GTA-style HUD
summary: The Fédération française de golf filmed a golf cart round with a GTA-style interface on top, including a mini-map, wanted stars and a money counter, and said it was ready for 18 holes at the 'Vice City Golf Club'. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Firefox shows off its glow-up 'before GTA 6'
summary: Firefox posted a before-and-after of its mascot from the GTA V era to now: 'We got a glow up too, more fire, more fox (and before GTA 6).'

title: Ford posts its Bronco, Ranger and Puma in game-like scenes
summary: Ford posted its Bronco, Ranger and Puma in game-like scenes, according to Autoblog.it. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: fynk writes a work leave contract for GTA 6 launch week
summary: Contract software company fynk published a free GTA 6 page offering two generated agreements: a relationship agreement for partners and a work leave agreement for launch week with an out-of-office reply. The PDFs are free and made in the browser, according to the brand's own page.

title: Energy drink brand cuts support hours so staff can play
summary: G Fuel posted a memo on X saying customer support replies would be slower in launch week so staff could play GTA 6, while core operations keep running. Coverage notes it is not a Rockstar or Take-Two collaboration.

title: G FUEL runs a GTA VI-themed 'Miami Heist' giveaway
summary: G FUEL's own giveaway page and X post (21 November) offer a grand prize of a PS5 Pro, a GTA VI game copy, a limited-edition GTA VI DualSense controller and a year's supply of G FUEL. Two runners-up each get a four-tub G FUEL bundle and a GTA VI copy. Entries run 1 to 30 November, US only, 18+, with missions to complete and a crew to recruit for extra entries. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: GameSir launches two GTA VI-inspired G7 Pro controllers
summary: GameSir revealed two G7 Pro controllers, the Sunset Boulevard Edition and Ocean Breeze Edition, with Miami-style colours and palm tree designs. Notebookcheck says there is no collaboration with Rockstar and that they work with Xbox, PC and Android. Beebom reports a price of $89.99 and says no release date was given.

title: GameStop CEO on code-in-a-box games: 'we're selling a lot of it'
summary: On GTA VI's launch eve, Ryan Cohen told Bloomberg that the move to all digital 'has hurt consumers, and it's also hurt GameStop', adding of code-in-a-box releases: 'we're selling a lot of it.' On 17 November he posted on X: 'GTA. On a disc. In a case. On your shelf.'

title: A Pindamonhangaba skewer bar sells a GTA-style couples combo
summary: Garagem Espetinhos, a skewer restaurant in Pindamonhangaba, worked with an iFood store manager on a launch-day combo for couples to share while playing, announced in the game's visual style. Its video got five times its usual engagement. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: GTA VI midnight launch events in Dubai
summary: UAE games retailer Geekay announced midnight launch events across its Dubai stores from 8pm on 11 November, promising activities and prizes. Which stores take part has not been listed.

title: "The Grand Game Deal" household GTA VI contracts
summary: Finnish electronics retailer Gigantti published printable contracts for households to agree GTA VI play time: release day (Easy), release week (Normal) or a month in return for favours like chores (Hard). Uploading a signed contract gives a 10% code on regular-priced gaming accessories and entry into a draw for a PS5 Slim and GTA VI, until 15 November; Gigantti says Rockstar, Take-Two and Sony are not involved.

title: Goat Simulator 3 ad pulled for using leaked GTA 6 footage
summary: An official Goat Simulator 3 advert used leaked GTA 6 gameplay and was taken down after a copyright report, presumed to be from Take-Two.

title: Gopuff opens a gaming storefront for GTA VI
summary: The delivery service created a gaming-themed storefront for the GTA VI launch, stocked with energy drinks, late-night snacks and gaming equipment, and told Modern Retail it expects demand to rise this week.

title: "GTA 6 needs to hurry up" post
summary: The Greensboro Police Department posted on X that GTA 6 "needs to hurry up and get here so y'all can stay at home and let us catch a break".

title: Grubhub's 'OUTOFOFFICE' code for GTA VI launch day
summary: Grubhub offered $10 off orders of $10 or more with the code OUTOFOFFICE from 9am ET on launch day, for the first 1,000 customers. Grubhub said the code ran out in under 90 minutes.

title: GWR cites longest game development record after delay
summary: Guinness World Records responded to the delay by pointing to Duke Nukem Forever's record for the longest video game development, 14 years and 43 days.

title: Havan's Osasco store offers free GTA VI play stations over launch weekend
summary: From 19 to 22 November Havan's store in Osasco offered free stations to try the game, with influencer appearances, and tied the launch to Black Friday with R$1,000 off the PlayStation 5 in its physical stores. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Hebron Police sends sympathy to the Vice City police
summary: Hebron Police in Ohio posted sympathy for the in-game force: "Thinking of you all at VCPD over the next few days."

title: Heineken: 'Don't drink and drive a stolen car'
summary: Heineken put a GTA spin on its responsible-drinking message with an Instagram post reading 'Don't drink and drive a stolen car', adding: 'Don't drink and drive. And don't steal cars. Unless you're in a video game.'

title: Heineken points gamers to the real Miami bars behind Vice City
summary: Heineken USA and agency LePub New York put digital outdoor ads outside Miami venues that inspired in-game locations, including Clevelander South Beach, Hotel Victor and Hotel Breakwater. Lines include 'Your next waypoint is a real bar'. On 19 November from 7 to 9pm Heineken invited gamers to have a beer on it at those venues.

title: Heinz makes real bottles of GTA VI's 'GORGE' ketchup
summary: After players spotted a familiar-looking condiment called GORGE in GTA VI footage, Heinz brought the fictional bottle into the real world as a limited-edition collectible filled with classic Heinz ketchup. It is a limited-time giveaway that fans can enter to win, not a product on sale.

title: Huggies: 'Protection for the Biggest Releases'
summary: Huggies and agency DAVID New York borrowed the San Andreas line 'Ah shit, here we go again' for a launch-week ad selling blowout protection to parents. The joke is that 13 years passed between GTA V and GTA VI, long enough for players to become parents. Reel 360 made it its Reel Ad of the Week.

title: Hush Puppies Indonesia: 'Next mission? Walk Jason'
summary: Hush Puppies Indonesia posted its dog mascot in a GTA-style scene with the line 'Samantha equipped. Next mission? Walk Jason.'

title: Hyperoptic offers three months free broadband for GTA VI
summary: Hyperoptic offered new 1Gbps customers three months free, saying it was worth £78, more than a copy of GTA 6, and paused planned network work on pre-load day, 12 November. Separate from its launch-night traffic data.

title: Hyperoptic: launch eve its busiest night of the month
summary: Hyperoptic said last-minute downloaders made GTA VI launch eve the busiest night of the past month on its full fibre network, with traffic peaking around 30% above a typical evening, according to its own network data. It said players who preloaded since 10 November meant there was no surge at midnight.

title: Hyundai Santa Fe in GTA VI art style
source_name: J'ai un pote dans la com
summary: Hyundai Worldwide put its Santa Fe SUV under a saturated Vice City sunset in Rockstar-style artwork.

title: 'Grand Test Auto XXIV' live-action trailer remake
summary: Hyundai Motorsport released a shot-for-shot live-action parody of the first GTA 6 trailer starring its rally team and cars.

title: iFood curates snacks to stock up on 'before you press play'
summary: Delivery app iFood put together an in-app selection for players planning a marathon, under the line 'Garanta Tudo Antes de dar play', with snacks, chocolate, drinks and energy drinks from markets, convenience stores and restaurants, tied to Black Friday and backed by a video with a singer and influencer. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: IKEA France puts its FRAKTA bag on GTA-style cover art
summary: IKEA France drew a shopper in the style of the game's cover, in front of Vice City skyscrapers and palm trees, carrying a full blue FRAKTA bag still priced at 1 euro, captioned 'On est prêts.' There is no Rockstar deal.

title: IKEA Hong Kong: leave for games 13 years ago vs now
summary: IKEA Hong Kong compared asking a teacher for leave 13 years ago with asking the boss now, to sell its YXSTABY gaming TV stand on castors. The post passed 800 likes.

title: Chennai design firm Inde by ChairsCarte closes for GTA VI
summary: Indian interior design firm Inde by ChairsCarte has declared a company-wide holiday on 19 November for employees, interns and freelancers so they can play GTA VI. Founder and CEO Kishore Shanmugam announced it on Instagram, recalling that staff grew up playing Vice City and GTA V.

title: Indus Towers: 'Virtual worlds need non-stop connectivity'
summary: Indian telecom tower firm Indus Towers posted a sunset-toned, comic-panel GTA-style collage of people on their screens with a tower at the centre: "Virtual worlds need non-stop connectivity. That's our game."

title: Influish gives all staff paid leave on GTA VI launch day
summary: Indian company Influish gave its roughly 50 employees paid leave on launch day, and said staff without a PS5 could come into the office and play on its gaming setup.

title: Software studio closes for two days for GTA VI launch
summary: Innoveev, a software studio, says it is off on Thursday 19 and Friday 20 November for the GTA VI launch and back on Saturday 21 November. Its operations team stays online to watch systems and answer support; new project enquiries, calls and design reviews pause. Announced on its own blog by founder and CEO Hasan Kassas.

title: InPost offers GTA VI codes for 3,500 InCoins
summary: Wirtualnemedia.pl reports that InPost said it would make GTA VI codes for PlayStation 5 available in its loyalty programme for 3,500 InCoins, its loyalty points.

title: ITV's "TV Joint Custody Agreement"
summary: ITV and social agency Block Report posted a mock, not legally binding contract to help households split TV time between GTA VI and telly. There is no Rockstar involvement.

title: JBL gaming headset in Vice City setting
source_name: J'ai un pote dans la com
summary: JBL placed its gaming headset in a Vice City scene, linking it to the series' soundtrack.

title: JBL sponsors a Miami GTA VI launch day with Clix
summary: Audio brand JBL is sponsoring a Miami event where streamers including Cody 'Clix' Conrod play GTA VI together on launch day, with a Clix meet-and-greet at a Micro Center store. JBL is using the launch to promote its new Quantum 950X headset. JBL head of gaming Bryce Showalter called GTA VI 'a landmark moment for gaming culture'. No deal with Rockstar is mentioned.

title: Just Eat's 'ChEAT Button' controller lets players order food mid-game
summary: Just Eat unveiled a limited-edition 'Stay In The Game' controller on 19 November with a dedicated 'ChEAT Button': once synced to a Just Eat account, pressing it places a food order without pausing play. UK streamers Angry Ginge and Danny Aarons are showing it on Twitch and giving it away through their socials, with three months of Just Eat credit worth £300 (£100 a month until the end of January). Just Eat also offered free delivery from selected restaurants and retailers between 6pm on 19 November and 5am on 20 November. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: KaBuM! turns a Paulista space into 'KaBuM! City' on launch eve
summary: Magazine Luiza's games retailer KaBuM! turned a space at Galeria Magalu on Avenida Paulista into 'KaBuM! City' the day before launch, with an arena for earlier GTA games, actors in character, themed giveaways and free entry. It says more than 800 people came and sales there were 567% above a normal day. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Kalshi posts a 'BREAKING' claim about a fan renting a hotel room to play GTA 6
summary: Prediction market Kalshi posted on X: 'BREAKING: GTA 6 fan rents hotel room for a whole week to play the game without being bothered by wife'. The post names no fan and gives no source for the claim. It follows Kalshi's paid 'GTA VI researcher' job ad.

title: Kalshi advertises a paid 'GTA VI researcher' job to livestream the game
summary: Prediction market Kalshi posted a job ad for a 'GTA VI researcher' to start playing at midnight on 19 November, livestream on YouTube or Twitch and study the in-game economy. Mint reports a base of $100,000 to $120,000 plus a $15,000 bonus, and TechJuice says up to $135,000. The ad says 'This is a real job', and the role includes weekly reports.

title: Kerala Tourism swaps Vice City beaches for tea hills
summary: Kerala Tourism posted a GTA-style poster reading 'Great trips ahead', swapping Vice City's beaches for tea-covered hills, fishing nets and backwaters, according to CNBC TV18.

title: KFC Australia holds a funeral for 'Ann Alibi' on GTA VI launch day
summary: KFC Australia staged a funeral on launch day, 19 November, for a fictional woman called 'Ann Alibi', born on 28 November 1997, the launch date of the original GTA. It began with a funeral invite on Instagram; when the post passed 6,000 likes, KFC unlocked free nationwide delivery for the day. Fans gathered at KFC Robina on the Gold Coast for a service led by comedian Matt Hey and got a Certificate of Attendance as their alibi, with a livestream on Instagram. Campaign Brief credits We Are Social (social) and Ogilvy PR, with Those That Do on the experience.

title: KFC Gaming 'leaks' GTA 6 screenshots
summary: KFC Gaming tweeted 'LEAKED GTA 6 SCREENSHOTS' with only a sensitive-content warning image, trolling fans waiting for news.

title: KFC Hong Kong's 'Good tarts ahhhh' egg tarts for the download wait
summary: KFC Hong Kong pitched Portuguese egg tarts to players stuck watching GTA VI's huge download, with the line "Good tarts ahhhh".

title: KFC posts CJ 'not again' meme after delay
summary: KFC's X account reacted to the delay to 19 November 2026 with CJ's famous 'not again' line from GTA San Andreas.

title: KFC Spain gives out fried chicken 'Replacement Discs' for code-only GTA VI boxes
location: 10 KFC restaurants in Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, Zaragoza and Málaga, Spain
summary: Because physical GTA VI boxes hold only a download code, KFC Spain's 'The Replacement Disc' gave anyone who brought a GTA VI box a fried chicken disc in a game-style case with Colonel Sanders on the cover. It ran on 19 and 20 November, 4pm to 8pm, at 10 restaurants in five cities while stocks lasted.

title: KFC's 'Cluck n' Bell' pink Cadillac delivers in London
summary: Dexerto reports that KFC UK and Ireland announced 'Cluck n' Bell', a nod to GTA's Cluckin' Bell, on 17 November: on 19 November a hot pink 1959 Cadillac convertible with Cluck n' Bell branding will deliver a 'one-handed gaming feast' to a limited number of competition winners in London. Entry is via a KFC competition form for London residents aged 18 and over. It is not an official Rockstar collaboration, and we have not seen KFC's own post.

title: KFC offers $0 delivery all GTA VI launch weekend
summary: KFC offered free delivery at select US locations from 19 to 22 November on app and web orders, posting "imagine pausing the game to go out and get food when we literally have $0 delivery all weekend". Separate from KFC Australia's Ann Alibi funeral.

title: Kick's 'Sunset Reward Case' gives away 10,000 GTA VI codes to viewers
summary: Streaming platform Kick launched a Sunset Reward Case on 12 November, running until 7 December: viewers who watch any stream for 180 minutes a day can open a case for a chance to win one of 10,000 GTA VI Ultimate Edition codes for PS5 or Xbox. Codes will not be issued before launch on 19 November. Kick says the promotion is run independently and is not affiliated with Rockstar or Take-Two. It is promoting the giveaway with a truck-sized loot case on the streets of Los Angeles, driven by a Lucia cosplayer.

title: Missing KitKat truck turns up in a Vice City-style teaser
summary: KitKat posted a GTA VI-styled video of a red KitKat truck cruising past palm trees and pastel buildings, captioned "About those missing KitKats, stay tuned". It plays on the real theft of about 12 tonnes of KitKat in transit from Italy to Poland in March 2026; there is no deal with Rockstar. After a series of teasers, KitKat posted the payoff on Instagram: police chase a KitKat van through a GTA-style city, a man runs into a lamppost carrying a wanted sign, then wakes to eat a KitKat as the word 'rested' appears, pointing viewers to a 'rested' filter game on TikTok.

title: Free GTA 6 for babies born on launch day
summary: Norwegian electronics retailer Komplett offered a free copy of GTA 6 to parents whose baby is born on 19 November 2026, promoted on Instagram and with in-store ads.

title: Lamborghini posts a Revuelto in pink, purple and blue
summary: Lamborghini posted a Revuelto in pink, purple and blue, according to Autoblog.it. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: LTA: 'If he can memorise the GTA6 map, he can memorise the MRT map'
summary: Singapore's Land Transport Authority set the MRT system map next to Rockstar's map of Leonida: "If he can memorise the entire GTA6 map, he can memorise the Singapore MRT System Map."

title: Surrey landscaper Lawnkeepers gives its six staff launch day off
summary: Lawnkeepers Landscaping is giving its six employees Thursday off for GTA VI. Co-owner Angad Toor proposed it months ago; his father and co-owner Bal Toor told CBC the team has been working six days a week and will get together and order pizza.

title: "Let's Play GTA VI" launch night at Le Grand Rex
location: Le Grand Rex, Salle Infinite, Paris, France
summary: The historic Paris cinema will show GTA VI on its giant screen from 8pm to midnight on launch day, with streamer Vlad_CKa playing live on stage plus a show and giveaway, ticketed via Shotgun. It is organised by Iconic Production, with no Rockstar involvement stated.

brand: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight
title: LEGO Batman 'delays his trip to Miami'
summary: The LEGO Batman game account joked that Batman had to postpone his Miami trip after the GTA 6 delay.

title: Leroy Merlin gets ready for 'GTASSIS'
summary: Leroy Merlin posted 'Prêt pour la sortie de GTASSIS', a pun on 'assis' (seated), with AI-generated visuals of a player starting the game sat on a paint tin, and asked followers whether they prefer a stepladder or a pouffe. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Libas: 'Grand Styles Theft Auto 6: The Libas Heist'
summary: Indian fashion brand Libas posted 'Grand Styles Theft Auto 6: The Libas Heist', with a convertible, shopping bags and a 'Mission Passed' banner, according to CNBC TV18.

title: GTA-style supermarket mission reel
summary: Lidl CZ posted an Instagram reel that plays a supermarket shop as a GTA mission, complete with minimap and on-screen prompts. It uses no game footage and is not a Rockstar partnership.

title: Linkhouse jokes about launch-day leave and doubles points during Black Weeks
summary: Wirtualnemedia.pl reports that Linkhouse joked about employees taking time off for the launch while reminding customers that GTA VI is in its loyalty rewards catalogue. The post was paired with double points on orders during Black Weeks.

title: LINX: Manchester exchange traffic up 41% as GTA VI goes live
summary: The London Internet Exchange said traffic at midnight was up 16.14% against the six-week average across its networks, with LINX Manchester up 41% as northern networks exchanged traffic locally. Its CEO said the launch had gone better than the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III launch in 2023.

title: Logitech gives its staff a day off for GTA VI launch
summary: Logitech has declared 19 November its "Logi Game Day", giving staff a day off to play a new game; Kotaku puts the company at just over 7,000 employees. The policy works for any game, but Logitech said that if employees spend the day "exploring Vice City on launch day, you won't hear any complaints from us". CEO Hanneke Faber told Fortune it was "time to retire the stereotype that gaming is a waste of time". There is no deal with Rockstar.

title: McDonald's puts McDelivery inside Discord for launch week
summary: McDonald's USA launched an 'Order McDonald's' activity on Discord 'just in time for the biggest video game release of the decade', letting players order McDelivery through Uber Eats without leaving their server. While they wait they can play 'Fast Lane Feast', a Discord-only mini game with a leaderboard. The release does not name Rockstar, and there is no deal with the game.

title: Maccies UK teases Vice City-style post
summary: McDonald's UK posted an Instagram image of a McDonald's bag on a palm-tree island in Vice City-style sunset colours, and replied to fans suggesting a GTA 6 meal with 'Incredible' and an eyes emoji. No collaboration has been announced.

title: McDonald's France hopes to bring back Le M before GTA 7
summary: Rather than talk about the game, McDonald's France joked about the long wait: its 'niche dream' is to bring back its Le M burger before GTA 7 comes out, adding that it should still have time. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: McDonald's in Winschoten recruits staff with a GTA VI-style poster
summary: A McDonald's restaurant in Winschoten put up a recruitment poster that closely mimics the GTA VI cover art. Customers shared it on social media and it went viral. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: MediaMarkt runs 19 GTA VI event days in the Netherlands and Belgium
summary: MediaMarkt ran 19 event days and more than 100 hours of activity in five stores in the Netherlands and Belgium from 12 to 18 November, including a game dome in Amsterdam, a vault game in Rotterdam and a wheel of fortune in Breda, plus 'Arcade City' Twitch livestreams on seven evenings. Partners included PlayStation, Samsung, Logitech, Philips and Red Bull, and Fletcher Hotels gave away an overnight stay for two on each stream. Neither source says whether this Benelux activation is a Rockstar deal.

title: Mercedes-Benz: no Carl and Bertha Benz, no auto to steal
summary: Mercedes-Benz posted human-made art by car illustrator Andrew Mytro showing a couple in vintage fashion, making the point that without Carl and Bertha Benz there might be no auto to steal. Creative Bloq picked it as one of the stronger brand reactions to the launch.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA joins GTA VI art trend
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA's GTA VI-style post was embedded in Creative Bloq's round-up of brand trendjacking, with no further detail given.

brand: Hoy Como Ayer, The Scapegoat and Chug's Diner
title: Three Miami venues pour $14 GTA VI cocktails
summary: Hoy Como Ayer, The Scapegoat and Chug's Diner are serving limited-time GTA VI cocktails at $14, including a Bean Machine Cafecito, a Vice City Margarita and a Vercetti Margarita. Which venue serves which drink is not stated, and no Rockstar partnership is mentioned.

title: Dutch media agency offers two paid days to play GTA VI
summary: Fonk magazine reports that MIBTL Media, a media agency, has an internal arrangement giving employees two paid days, Thursday 19 and Friday 20 November, to play GTA VI, with conditions: staff share screenshots, complete challenges and document moments as proof of progress. Quotes managing director Viktor Wubbe. The article is dated 30 June 2026 and is the only source found, so treat the arrangement as reported rather than confirmed.

title: "Migi City" AI trailer in GTA VI style
summary: The Swiss supermarket posted an AI-made Instagram Reel styled as a trailer for a fictional game, "Migi City", including a scene of a cashier and customer making gun gestures. Migros says there is no tie-up with Rockstar; one analysis of 262 visible comments found close to 60% negative, though some early reactions were enthusiastic.

title: MINI posts its convertible in a neon Vice City-style setting
summary: MINI posted an Instagram carousel of a MINI Cooper S Convertible against a waterfront skyline, palm trees and a pink-purple sunset, captioned "POV: you just unlocked a whole new level of always open" with the hashtag #OpenWorld, and marked the images as created using AI.

title: Modelo's Model0% recreates GTA VI scenes: 'Real life has no restart'
summary: Cerveza Modelo and agency GUT recreated recognisable GTA VI scenes shot for shot, with the same characters, wardrobe and locations, as responsible drinking ads for its zero-alcohol Model0% under the line 'Real life has no restart'. The campaign started when fans spotted a Modelo bottle in the game's trailers, according to LBB.

title: Mooyah sells a '6-STAR Combo' for GTA VI week
summary: Mooyah is selling a limited-time 6-STAR Combo online from 19 to 29 November, a nod to the wanted-level stars. Rewards members who order it while logged in get an entry to win a PS5 Digital Edition and a GTA VI code.

title: National Museum in Kraków turns paintings into gaming and sick-day memes
summary: Wirtualnemedia.pl reports that the National Museum in Kraków used paintings from its collection to make memes about gaming and missing work around the GTA VI launch.

title: Mwave's 'Diary Killer' fills work calendars so gamers can play GTA 6
summary: Australian gaming retailer Mwave and agency The General Store launched Diary Killer, a tool that fills a gamer's work calendar with believable fake meetings based on their role so they can play GTA VI on launch day. It launched as Australia's government warned employees about their leave obligations.

title: Nando's 'Grand Theft Order' drops meal vouchers into other brands' GTA posts
summary: Nando's South Africa and agency Retroviral dropped meal voucher codes into other South African brands' GTA comment sections and creators' live-stream chats, then invited players to screenshot chickens in GTA VI with #GrandTheftOrder for a chance of a real meal. It runs in South Africa, the UK and Australia.

title: India's Prime Minister posts 'how India upgraded' between GTA V and GTA VI
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi marked launch day with an Instagram post comparing India at GTA V's 2013 release with today, captioned "Between GTA V and GTA VI, here's how India upgraded" and "India is playing a whole new game". The opposition Congress called it a desperate bid to reach young people.

title: NBN Co says launch night set its all-time network record
summary: NBN Co told TechRadar that overnight into 19 November, as GTA VI launched in Australia, its network hit 36.54Tbps, 'the most data we've ever moved in a single second'.

title: NESCAFÉ South Africa offers a caffeine boost for late-night GTA VI sessions
summary: NESCAFÉ South Africa used the GTA VI launch to remind late-night players that its coffee can keep them going. It is a brand reaction, not a Rockstar partnership.

title: Netto sells GTA VI pre-orders and a 'Heist Deal' snack bundle
summary: Under the line 'Dein Game. Deine Nacht.', Netto sold the PS5 Standard Edition in its online shop from 9 to 14 November for 79.99 euros, and in stores ran a 'Heist Deal': a Gamberina Gaming Pizza with a Booster energy drink and a game-look doughnut for 3 euros. A 360-degree campaign ran across leaflets, in-store radio, app, newsletter and digital ads.

title: NHS England posts its social media manager's bandaged hand ahead of GTA 6
summary: On 16 November the official @nhs Instagram account posted a four-photo carousel of its social media manager's heavily bandaged thumb after surgery to remove a lump, with on-screen text reading "NHS England Social Media Manager in race to be fit for release of GTA6", and advised people planning to game later that week to take regular breaks and be mindful of repetitive strain injury.

title: Nissan thanks the games its 1990s classics inspired, with a Jason or Lucia contest
summary: With Havas Play, Nissan ran a four-step Instagram operation: a 16 November story quiz on classic models such as the Skyline GT-R R32, Patrol Y60 and Silvia S13, its community manager taking 19 November off, an 'open letter to those we inspired' on launch day presenting their successors, and from 23 November a contest for people called Jason or Lucia. GTA is never named. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: North Miami Police: the city 'is NOT a free-roam server'
summary: North Miami Police posted reminders against street racing and for obeying traffic laws: "What happens in Vice City stays in Vice City. What happens in North Miami might end up in a police report."

title: Nothing lists everything it shipped before GTA VI
summary: Nothing posted its product list, from Phone (1) to Nothing OS 5, as "things we shipped before GTA VI", signing off "see you in vice city".

title: O2 opens GTA VI PS5 bundle pre-orders from 41p a day
summary: O2 opened pre-orders for two PS5 and GTA VI bundles, from £145 upfront then 0% instalments equal to 41p a day, shipping from 12 November. Separate from its under-5p-a-day game offer.

title: Octopus compares its card-to-mobile story with the 13-year wait
summary: Payment provider Octopus paired a physical Octopus card, as the previous GTA, with Mobile Octopus, as GTA 6, to show how it has changed in 13 years.

title: Betting site prices GTA 6 delay, songs and cameos
summary: Betting tips site OLBG published GTA 6 'specials' odds, including 7/1 on another delay past November and odds on radio songs and celebrity cameos.

title: UK survey on GTA 6 sick days and leave
summary: One Day Agency commissioned a YouGov survey of 1,000 UK adults on launch day plans, finding 7% expected to book the day off and 15% might call in sick if they could not.

title: Optik Seis ties GTA VI to its own centenary
summary: The Indonesian eyewear retailer posted GTA-style art of its stores, products and customers: 'GTA VI drops this week. Our 100th is still loading. 99 will do for now.'

title: Panther Coffee releases a limited GTA VI coffee collection
location: Miami (Wynwood, Little Haiti, Coconut Grove, MiMo) and online
summary: Miami roaster Panther Coffee is selling Stockyard and Mount Kalaga 'GTAVI' blends at $30 each, with worldwide shipping from 19 November. Forbes adds GTA VI cups with collectible stirrers in its cafes; no Rockstar partnership is stated.

title: Paris FC puts its stadium in Vice City dusk
source_name: J'ai un pote dans la com
summary: The football club showed its Jean Bouin stadium and the Eiffel Tower in GTA VI-style mauve dusk artwork.

title: Pastelerías La Esperanza turns a bakery run into a GTA-style mission
summary: Pastelerías La Esperanza illustrated two GTA-style characters with a car outside one of its bakeries, captioned 'La misión era pasar por un bolillo. Salimos de Esperanza con tres bolsas.' There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Patties hands out 400 symbolic 'sick notes' for launch day
summary: Burger chain Patties gave out 400 symbolic time-off notes across five restaurants on 18 and 19 November, playing on players skipping work for the launch, and turned its restaurants into meeting points for fans. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Pemex presents energy sovereignty as a Vice City 'new mission'
summary: Pemex, Mexico's state oil company, illustrated one of its petrol stations among palm trees under a pink and purple sky, presenting energy sovereignty as a 'new mission'. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Delhi beauty brand Personal Touch Skincare declares 19 November a holiday
summary: CNA reports that Delhi-based beauty products brand Personal Touch Skincare announced 19 November as a holiday for employees in posts on social media, as GTA VI fever spilled into Indian workplaces.

title: Philips TV France pitches Ambilight as police-chase 'gyrophares' on the walls
summary: Philips TV in France posted an Ambilight ad: 'Si tu vas passer des heures à semer la police... autant avoir les gyrophares qui continuent jusque sur les murs'. Virginie Guimaraes, marketing lead France, posted it on LinkedIn, according to RMC. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Pima County Sheriff: 'Real-life laws don't come with cheat codes'
summary: Pima County Sheriff's Office told GTA VI fans: "Real-life laws don't come with cheat codes, respawns, or mission restarts."

title: Pizza Hut Brazil's 'FDS 6' pixel-art game pays out in pizza coupons
summary: Pizza Hut created FDS 6, a pixel-art game where players clear everyday obstacles such as meetings, traffic and chores, and earn coupons for pizza in the app or in restaurants. It ran from 16 to 18 November, counting down to launch. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Pizza Hut's 'GTA 6IX' delivery campaign in Toronto
summary: Pizza Hut's "GTA 6IX" delivery campaign by agency Diamond put a battered Honda Civic on Toronto's streets as a physical extension of Vice City.

title: Pizza Hut's delivery car tears through a GTA-style city
summary: Pizza Hut posted a game-style image of a delivery car speeding through a city with 'No one outpizzas the Hut' on the bag: 'If you see this guy booking it through the city mind your business he's delivering'.

title: Pizza Hut Hong Kong's 'Grab them all' gaming fuel pizza
summary: Pizza Hut Hong Kong set its Yuzu Kosho Salmon Star Cheesy Bites pizza against a Vice City-style backdrop with the line "Grab them all", as part of a limited offer running 29 October 2026 to 13 January 2027.

title: Plaza Toyota puts its hybrids into GTA 6
summary: The Indonesian Toyota dealer posted the Veloz Hybrid, Yaris Cross Hybrid, Innova Zenix Hybrid and Alphard Hybrid in GTA 6 style, joking they would be among the most fuel-efficient cars in the game.

title: Palworld studio Pocketpair gives staff a five-day 'business trip to Vice City'
summary: Pocketpair, the studio behind Palworld, announced on its official Palworld accounts on X that every employee has special leave for 'an urgent five-day business trip in Vice City' when GTA VI launches. The memo on company letterhead sets the leave from Thursday 19 November to Monday 23 November for any employee who intends to play. GTA BOOM says work on Palworld and Craftopia updates continues as scheduled, and calls it the most generous GTA VI time-off policy it has tracked.

title: Politie's 'Wanted. Collega's.' campaign recruits with GTA-style films
summary: The Dutch police ran a 'Wanted. Collega's.' recruitment campaign of GTA-style videos starring real officers, leading to a test that matches gaming skills to police roles. The Invaders made it, with Kevin Loos as creative director. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Popeyes launches the 'Spice City' chicken sandwich on GTA VI day
summary: Popeyes has confirmed a Spice City chicken sandwich, available from 19 November to 22 November, the same day as the game. IGN reports it has two chicken fillets, pickles and a choice of spicy or regular mayo on a brioche bun, from about $6 depending on location. Popeyes says it pays homage to an in-game sandwich and can be ordered via its app and delivery services. IGN describes it as riding the hype rather than a Rockstar deal.

title: Posh Management: 'Thursday is officially OFF' for GTA VI
summary: Posh Management posted a GTA VI holiday notice for launch day that read: "Thursday is officially OFF." Gulf News listed it among companies declaring a holiday for 19 November.

title: PostNL's 'Midnight Release' delivers GTA 6 in the middle of the night
summary: PostNL's 'Midnight Release' had a PostNL employee and a creator deliver a GTA 6 Ultimate Edition package in the middle of the night to three gamers, Morrog, Ayv3e and Martin Verschoor, around the night of 11 to 12 November. The Invaders was the agency. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: One-of-one Vice City Hermès Birkin, covered in Swarovski crystals
summary: Privé Porter and Moneybags x MB unveiled a one-of-one pink Hermès Birkin covered in Swarovski crystals, as a Vice City tribute. The bag is an independent customisation of a genuine Birkin, not an official Hermès or Rockstar collaboration. Privé Porter posted it on Instagram with the line "We got a Vice City Birkin before GTA 6!". Hypebeast covered it on 18 November. Lana Del Rey was later photographed with it at a Miami launch event, according to Page Six. No price was announced.

title: Prosper Police: 'Save the reckless driving for the game'
summary: Prosper Police in Texas used the release to remind drivers to follow traffic laws, put phones down and respect speed limits: "Save the reckless driving for the game."

title: Indian ride app redraws its fleet GTA-style
source_name: J'ai un pote dans la com
summary: Rapido restyled its auto rickshaws, bikes and drivers in GTA VI vector illustration style.

title: Reddit shares UK GTA audience data and tells brands to add value for players
summary: Lewis Tutssel, Industry Creative Lead for Gaming at Reddit, told Marketing Chief that Grand Theft Auto generated more than 247 million views in the UK between August and October, while the r/GTA6 community grew by more than 50 per cent. He said interest spiked around the extended trailer and kept going as fans dissected footage and hunted for Easter eggs. His advice to brands thinking about joining in: "create real value for players, putting them before your own marketing objectives".

title: Remote data shows GTA VI launch-day leave up 32%
summary: HR and payroll platform Remote says leave booked for 19 November is 32% higher than the same Thursday in 2025, the biggest jump for any game launch since 2022, with the UK at 1.42x and Gen Z at nearly double. Its 'Wanted: Time Off' page uses bookings as of 5 November and says about 1 in 170 leave notes name the game.

title: Rosa Sky rooftop hosts a 'Vice City: Game On' launch night
summary: The Brickell rooftop bar is running a one-night GTA-inspired takeover on launch day, with themed cocktails like Sky City and 5 Star, a 'Caviar on Credit' tequila shot with a caviar bump and a free caviar bump for those who RSVP. It is not a Rockstar partnership.

title: Samsung and ID.nl host a 'Miami Mansion' in Amsterdam for launch week
summary: Samsung and tech site ID.nl (publisher Reshift) welcomed partners, press and consumers to a Miami-style 'Miami Mansion' in a house on the IJ in Amsterdam in the days around launch, with creators, livestreams and a giant ultrawide gaming monitor as the hero product. Neither names GTA, referring only to 'the game' and 'the release of the year'. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Sanguich adds a 'Vice City Special' Cuban sandwich
summary: Little Havana sandwich shop Sanguich has a limited 'Vice City Special' Cuban-style sandwich, with themed artwork made with Miami graffiti collective MSG Crew. No Rockstar partnership is stated. WSVN reports Sanguich now has three GTA-themed items, including a 'Miami Vice' turkey and ham club, chicharrones and a blue guava lemonade with coconut milk, and is giving out goodie bags with matches, a lighter, stickers and coasters, according to CEO Daniel Figueredo.

title: Sensor Tower estimates GTA VI pre-orders at $1.18 billion
summary: The market data firm launched a GTA VI sales tracker and estimated about 12 million pre-ordered units worth roughly $1.18 billion, against 7 million for GTA V. The figures are Sensor Tower estimates, not official sales numbers.

title: SERHANT gives all staff a floating holiday after a GTA VI likes challenge
summary: Real estate firm SERHANT's founder Ryan Serhant told an employee in a video they needed 400,000 likes to close the office; it passed 1.6 million. A memo seen by Business Insider gives all employees an extra floating holiday this year, usable on launch day.

title: Sky Broadband hits an all-time traffic high on GTA VI eve
summary: Sky Broadband said download traffic hit an all-time high of 31.3Tbps at 21:10 on 18 November, beating the Arsenal v Atletico Madrid record, with about 1,487PB downloaded from pre-load day to midday on launch day.

title: Silesian Zoo invites the loved ones of people absorbed in GTA VI
summary: Wirtualnemedia.pl reports that the Silesian Zoo used the launch to invite the loved ones of people absorbed in the game to visit.

title: Snappy Shopper's £5.99 GTA 6 Snack Bundle
summary: UK convenience delivery app Snappy Shopper is running a 'GTA 6 Snack Bundle' in participating stores from 17 to 21 November: a Red Bull four-pack, a Pringles tub and two Haribo packs for £5.99, against £11.49 RRP, with a dedicated banner category or pop-up. Customers who used a coupon code from 19 October to 17 November were entered into a draw for an Xbox or PS5 with GTA 6, with winners drawn on 18 November.

title: Snooze offers free delivery for launch with code GTADELIVERY
summary: The US breakfast chain is offering free nationwide delivery on 19 and 20 November through its own online ordering with the promo code GTADELIVERY, with no minimum order.

title: SA Police: 'In real life, there are no respawns'
summary: South Australia Police used the launch for a road safety post on the "Fatal Five": "Keep the chaos on screen, not on our roads. Because in real life, there are no respawns."

title: Spearmint Rhino recreates GTA VI strip club dances
location: London, UK and West Palm Beach, US
summary: Strip club chain Spearmint Rhino hired a choreographer to recreate lap dances inspired by two clubs in GTA VI, Jack of Hearts in Vice City and Delights Cabaret in Port Gellhorn, after what it said were hundreds of fan requests. Through 30 November, guests at its London and West Palm Beach venues get free admission on presenting a valid GTA VI purchase receipt and photo ID. Chain president and COO Kathy Vercher said the company joined in because of the fan demand.

title: Specsavers' 'biggest partnership of all time' is with GTA Transport, not GTA VI
summary: Specsavers teased its "biggest partnership of all time" on Instagram, then revealed it is sponsoring GTA Transport Ltd, a road haulage company in Leicester, rather than the game. Every GTA Transport driver is offered a free eye test. Specsavers' brand partnerships and sponsorships lead Neil Liddle told B&T: "It might not be the GTA partnership I originally had in mind but a deal's a deal."

title: Spectrum reportedly hides 500 hard drives in New York and LA
location: New York and Los Angeles, USA
summary: Adweek reports that Spectrum is hiding 500 hard drives across New York and Los Angeles to help players with GTA VI's huge install size. No Spectrum or Charter announcement has been found, so this is reported, not confirmed. It is separate from Spectrum's free Gig Speed Lift.

title: Free "Gig Speed Lift" to download GTA VI faster
summary: Charter's Spectrum is giving eligible US home internet customers a free boost to 1 Gig (2 Gig for some existing 1 Gig customers) from 9 to 30 November, opted into via the My Spectrum app. It pitches the offer as a way to download Grand Theft Auto VI "in less than 30 minutes", with no sign of a deal with Rockstar.

title: Spotify shares GTA VI trailer streaming spike data
summary: Spotify shared data on how songs in the GTA VI Extended Look trailer grew after it went live on Netflix. Captain & Tennille's "But I Think It's a Dream" rose 130,730%, from a small base of just over 194,000 lifetime streams, with Chimbala and Omega up 10,190% and Cliff Richard's "Devil Woman" up 1,290%. Spotify also highlighted rises in Gen Z discovery for Cliff Richard, Chimbala and Prefab Sprout.

title: State Farm parks a Vice City OOH truck beside Miami's GTA murals
summary: State Farm produced a Vice City activation in Miami on 18 November, which it says was not an official partnership with Rockstar. A mobile billboard of Jake from State Farm appeared beside existing GTA VI murals with the lines 'Need auto theft coverage? Get State Farm.' and 'Drive safe, Vice City,' and a companion survey found 60% of fans said they would drive less on 19 November, 40% significantly less, and 66% were likely to avoid driving to maximize the time they will be playing the game.

title: SteelSeries 'Getaway Plan' GTA giveaway
summary: SteelSeries ran a sign-up giveaway called 'The Getaway Plan', with gaming earbuds, KontrolFreek grips, GTA 6 launch copies and GTA Online cash cards as prizes. The page did not mention Rockstar and gave no dates. It has since been taken down; an archived copy from April 2025 remains.

title: Subway renames its Miami Cubano the 'Vice City Cubano'
summary: Subway has renamed its existing Cubano Pulled Pork Melt the Vice City Cubano for the GTA VI launch, with hardwood-smoked pulled pork, Black Forest ham, provolone, pickles and mustard on Italian bread. It is sold only in Miami, in six-inch and footlong sizes, in store, online and through the Subway app, with delivery. No Rockstar partnership is stated.

title: Downtown Miami restaurant Tâm Tâm gets a Vice City mural
summary: Vietnamese restaurant Tâm Tâm had its exterior painted with a Vice City mural ahead of the GTA VI launch, the Miami Herald reports. The artist and exact date are not given, and it is not named as a Rockstar partner.

title: Tamil Nadu Police: 'Grand Theft Demolisher' anti-drugs creative
summary: Tamil Nadu Police borrowed the game's look for an anti-drugs campaign titled 'Grand Theft Demolisher', showing a khaki-clad officer watching suspects led away in handcuffs. CNBC TV18 reported it as one of several Indian public bodies joining the launch moment.

title: Telepass shows its services as 'Mission Passed' in an in-game style reel
summary: Telepass marked launch day with an Instagram reel made with Twenty8 Studios: a mini clip in game-style graphics for each service, from motorway tolls, fuel and parking to airport fast track and ski passes, each ending on 'Mission Passed' in the game's font. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Telia Norway bundles GTA 6 with mobile plans
summary: Telia offered a digital code for GTA 6 Standard Edition to customers signing up to or upgrading qualifying mobile plans, typically on 24-month contracts. Coverage stresses it is a carrier offer, not a Rockstar one.

title: New York dispensary Terp Bros runs a GTA VI countdown and giveaways
summary: New York City cannabis dispensary Terp Bros, with its marketing firm Bud Authority, has run a 'Stock up before GTA VI drops' countdown banner since 9 November and is giving away four copies of the game, one a week from launch.

title: Thuisbezorgd.nl's 'Cheat Knop' controller orders a meal mid-game
summary: Thuisbezorgd.nl built a PS5 controller with an extra orange 'Cheat Knop' button that orders a preset favourite meal without pausing the game, with three minutes to cancel. It was up for grabs via social until 20 November with €300 of order credit, fronted by creators Qucee and Royalistic. Robot Kittens developed the controller, according to RTV Focus Zwolle. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: TIM streams the first GTA VI play from its Oscar Freire concept store
summary: TIM gathered creators João Dias, Malena and Gabriel Peixinho at its concept store on Rua Oscar Freire in São Paulo to play GTA VI for the first time in a midnight livestream, followed by a fan meet-up and a live show with Gaules, Liminha and BT0, plus Black Friday offers on the game and consoles. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Toblerone: 'Caught with 4.5kg'
summary: Toblerone posted a game-style image of a giant bar in a car boot with the words 'Caught with 4.5kg', a nod to the wanted-level system.

title: Tourism New Zealand welcomes the 'New Zealand trick' crowd
summary: New Zealand's tourist board posted on its PureNewZealand Instagram: 'One perk of seeing the sun first? Getting GTA 6 first too', adding that it had heard players were using the New Zealand time-zone trick and 'we'd love to have you'.

title: Toyota Spain Supra at a Vice City sunset
source_name: J'ai un pote dans la com
summary: Toyota España posted its Supra at a seaside sunset using the game's visual style.

title: Tripoholic closes its office for GTA VI
summary: Indian travel company Tripoholic gave employees, interns and freelancers a company-wide holiday on launch day: "The office is closed. The chaos is on!"

title: Turo's 'Cheat Codes' event lets Sydneysiders crack a code to win a car
summary: Car rental marketplace Turo ran a free one-day 'Cheat Codes' event at Campbells Cove on 14 November, where players cracked a classic-style vehicle cheat code on their phones to win a featured car, including a Porsche, for seven days. A trip for two to Miami, the real city behind gaming's best-known fictional destination, worth up to AUD 14,200, was also up for grabs. B&T says it was Turo's first activation with Wieden+Kennedy Sydney.

title: Turtle Beach headset on a Vice City gradient
source_name: J'ai un pote dans la com
summary: The gaming headset brand showed its headset on a pastel palm-tree gradient in GTA VI style.

title: Twitch to drop GTA VI Ultimate Edition codes daily until the end of November
summary: At the TwitchCon 2026 keynote, Twitch CEO Dan Clancy said the platform will surprise-drop digital codes for GTA VI Ultimate Edition every day from launch until the end of November. Its 'GTAVI Launch Celebration' Drops campaign runs from 18 to 30 November: six Chain badges for watching a participating stream for an hour on six separate days, six subscription badges and emotes, and a Golden Iguana badge for collecting all 12. Twitch has not said how many codes it will give away. Clancy also told Bloomberg on 12 November that Twitch has built ad technology so brands that want to be part of the GTA VI launch can keep their ads away from parts of the game they do not want to be associated with, which Dexerto reports should help streamers earn more from playing it.

title: Twix offers a professional body double so you can play GTA VI instead of working
summary: Mars Snacking's Twix and the Publicis Groupe OneMars team, which includes Leo UK, ran "Doppelgamer", a competition to win a real-life professional body double to handle the winner's day job so they could play GTA VI. The winner got a premium gaming setup and the stunt was streamed live on social platforms. Mars Snacking's Fabio Ruffet linked it to the so-called GTA flu of workers planning to call in sick.

title: Uber Eats France declares 19 November a 'sacred' day, not a holiday
summary: Uber Eats France posted a mock 'official statement' on a palm-tree and pink gradient background saying 19 November is no longer a public holiday but a 'sacred' day, with meal breaks allowed between missions as long as they are delivered: 'Ne quittez pas votre partie. On s'occupe du reste.' There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Uber Eats sprays a giant graffiti billboard in Berlin for launch day
summary: Uber Eats had its own billboard on Gneisenaustrasse in Berlin-Kreuzberg covered in oversized graffiti on launch day, as part of an international outdoor campaign aimed at gamers that never names the game. Mother Berlin is the agency. There is no Rockstar deal. Uber Eats offered $10 off orders of $20 or more with the code ONAMISSION, which it said was for GTA VI's launch day.

title: Uber Eats' 'ONAMISSION' launch-day code
summary: Uber Eats offered $10 off orders of $20 or more with the code ONAMISSION, which it said was for GTA VI's launch day.

title: Uncle Roger prescribes fried rice for 'GTA flu'
summary: Comedian Uncle Roger posted a game-style image of himself and his fried rice, suggesting fried rice for a speedy recovery to anyone taking sick leave for launch day.

title: Universal Pictures: 'me finishing literally everything before GTA 6'
summary: Universal Pictures posted a Bruce Almighty GIF of Jim Carrey captioned "me finishing literally everything before GTA 6".

brand: US Army (9th Engineer Battalion, Fort Stewart)
title: Army battalion offers GTA 6 leave as re-enlistment perk
summary: A memo dated 28 July offered soldiers of the 9th Engineer Battalion who re-enlisted between 1 August and 14 November a four-day pass from 20 to 23 November to play GTA 6. Dexerto noted the Army had not confirmed the memo; Fortune later reported 20 soldiers had taken up the offer.

title: Veronica offers five viewers €300 each to take 19 November off
summary: Dutch TV channel Veronica offered five viewers €300 each to cover a day off on 19 November, brought back the gaming show Gamekings for a special broadcast, and filled the week's schedule with action films and car chases. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Vice City Bean sells a 'Leonida' coffee blend for the GTA VI launch
summary: Miami coffee shop Vice City Bean is selling 'Leonida', a limited-edition medium roast of Colombian and Ethiopian beans, for $23 a 10-ounce bag through its online store. The shop's description says it celebrates Miami and the release of Rockstar Games' GTA VI. Beebom and Miami New Times both say the shop partnered with Rockstar, but the shop's own wording quoted by them does not say so, so treat the Rockstar link as reported.

title: Get paid €100 an hour to play GTA 6
summary: Virgin Media Ireland is recruiting one person to be paid €800 for eight hours of GTA 6 play, plus the game, in return for an honest social review tagged #Ad and posted between 20 and 26 November. Applications close in mid November (the page gives both 12 and 15 November).

title: GTA VI pre-loads break Virgin Media broadband records
summary: Virgin Media O2 said GTA VI pre-loads on 10 November pushed peak broadband traffic 3.8% above its previous record and daily data volume 4% above it. Its Strand Partners poll found half of working fans plan time off for the launch. On launch eve, 18 November, its broadband traffic between 8pm and 10pm was 9.4% above the pre-load record and 13.6% above the Arsenal v Atletico Madrid Champions League record, it said.

title: O2 lets gamers pay for GTA 6 at under 5p a day
summary: Virgin Media O2 launched a 0% finance pre-order: £20 upfront then £1.39 a month for 36 months, open to non-customers, with headlines noting the plan runs until 2029.

title: VisionTell's CEO trades a GTA VI day off for 10,000 likes
summary: Video content company VisionTell posted a clip of staff asking CEO John Schuster how many likes it would take to get a day off for GTA VI; he said 10,000. The video passed 378,000 likes in a day, and Schuster told Business Insider his team of six will get Friday off.

title: Vivo's 'The Last Mission' turns old GTA cash into real Brazilian reais
summary: Brazilian telecom brand Vivo let players convert credits built up in the previous GTA into real money paid into Vivo Pay digital accounts. Players had to find a Vivo Pay character placed on the game's map, transfer their virtual credits, and receive Brazilian reais at an exchange rate created for the activation. Ads of the World lists it as published in Brazil in November 2026 by Africa Creative.

title: Volvo: 99 years preventing collisions, 13 years waiting to cause them
summary: Volvo Cars posted a car on a purple-orange, GTA-style backdrop contrasting its 99 years of preventing collisions with fans' 13-year wait to cause them in the game; the only high rating it wants is for safety.

title: Wendy's teases something 'in the works', then drops a DoorDash streamer heist deal
summary: On 13 November Wendy's posted a GTA-style illustration of its red-headed mascot with gold hoop earrings, sipping from a Wendy's cup outside a restaurant against a Vice City-style backdrop, tagging artist Ravnita Rayet. The caption read "Our ride-or-dies are gonna love what we have in the works." Parade reports the post follows Wendy's own retro role-playing game, WendyQuest, earlier this month. No Rockstar deal has been announced and Wendy's has not said what it is planning. On 19 November Wendy's followed up with 'Your Next Big Heist': a DoorDash promotion giving $15 off $20+ Wendy's orders via codes dropped live in selected Twitch streamers' chats, 10am to 6pm PST, first 100 redemptions only, each code valid for 30 minutes, per DoorDash's terms page.

title: WhatsApp renames its X account 'WhatUp' after GTA VI's parody app
summary: WhatsApp temporarily renamed its X account WhatUp, the game's fake messaging app, swapped its green logo for a blue three-dot icon and posted "if you saw us in Vice City, no you didn't". CRED founder Kunal Shah also tagged the account asking "WhatsUp?".

brand: The White House / US government accounts
title: US government accounts post "before GTA 6" memes
summary: After Rockstar released the GTA VI cover art, the White House posted "We really saved America before GTA 6", and accounts for HHS Secretary Kennedy, CBP and the Department of Labor followed with their own versions over 18 and 19 June. Rockstar told Kotaku it had no comment.

title: White House posts a GTA-style 'Welcome to MAGA City' TikTok
summary: On the eve of launch, the White House posted a TikTok mixing clips of President Trump with GTA-inspired imagery, captioned "WELCOME TO MAGA CITY". There is no reported link to Rockstar.

title: Broadband firm calculates GTA 6 download times
summary: Full fibre provider Wildanet issued research on how long GTA 6 could take to download at different speeds, suggesting slower UK connections could take over a day.

title: Wingstop gives away PS5 and GTA VI packs at four Spanish restaurants
summary: On 20 and 21 November Wingstop ran an instant-win draw on its self-order kiosks at four restaurants in Madrid, Leganés and Barcelona: four packs of a PlayStation 5 and GTA VI plus 20 extra copies of the game, for orders of 14.90 euros or more. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: County Durham takeaway gives away a copy of GTA VI
source_name: Yahoo News UK (from The Northern Echo)
summary: Local takeaway Woodham Pizza ran a Facebook competition to win one copy of GTA VI, with entry by following, sharing and tagging friends, and the winner due to be named on 16 November.

title: Worldworthy gives staff up to three paid days off for GTA VI
summary: Worldworthy, which publishes the Worldworthy 100 rankings, is letting staff take up to three optional paid days off from launch day with no doctor's note needed, with Shay Kleiman quoted as saying the company "decided not to fight it". Only JFeed has reported this so far and Kleiman's role is unconfirmed; there is no deal with Rockstar.

title: x-kom holds an overnight GTA VI launch event in Warsaw
summary: Wirtualnemedia.pl reports that electronics retailer x-kom prepared a night event at its store in the G City Reduta centre in Warsaw, with gaming stations, contests and promotions.

title: Xbox and DJ Khaled's 'Dr. Xbox' writes notes for a day off
summary: Three days before launch, Xbox Wire ran a post by DJ Khaled as 'Dr. Xbox' pointing readers to DrXBOX.com for a personalised joke doctor's note for a day off, diagnosing a 'Vitamin G deficiency'. The post never names GTA VI, but games press read it as a launch-week play.

title: Xbox Series X-Bite alligator console sweepstakes
summary: Xbox revealed a one-off working Xbox Series X built into a five-foot animatronic alligator by John Nolan Studio, with a bitten controller in its jaws, as a US sweepstakes prize running 3 to 10 November. The post never names GTA VI but teases 'Xbox is heading to Florida', which press read as a nod to the game while PlayStation appears to hold the marketing rights.

title: Free 15-day WiFi speed boost for the GTA VI launch
summary: Comcast's Xfinity is giving eligible Xfinity Internet customers a free 15-day WiFi speed boost of up to 2 Gbps, timed to the 19 November launch of Grand Theft Auto VI, claimable in the Xfinity app or on its membership page from 9 November to 3 December. Xfinity says it expects 10 to 19 November, when pre-loads open, to be the busiest week ever on its network. The release names the game but mentions no deal with Rockstar.

title: XPENG jokes that its NGP is too law-abiding for Vice City
summary: XPENG posted a short X video of its NGP waiting at a red light in a Vice City-style city, joking that it is too law-abiding a car for the game, according to El País. There is no Rockstar deal.

title: Yamaha TMAX goes Vice City
source_name: J'ai un pote dans la com
summary: Yamaha's European accounts posted GTA VI-style artwork, with Yamaha Motor France showing its TMAX scooter in a Vice City street scene.

title: Zak the Baker sells a limited GTA VI cookie tin
summary: Miami bakery Zak the Baker has a limited-edition GTA VI cookie tin, with a GTA tote bag for the first 100 in-store buyers. No Rockstar partnership is stated.

title: Wrocław Zoo pairs GTA V and GTA VI logos with a penguin-numbers message
summary: Wirtualnemedia.pl reports that Wrocław Zoo set GTA V and GTA VI markings side by side with a note about falling penguin numbers.
Consumer electronics brand spotted in the Extended Look on a microwave, copiers and phones. Widely read as probably Samsung.
Software brand in official GTA 6 videos, widely read as probably Microsoft.
Mobile network brand in official GTA 6 videos, widely read as probably Sprint.
Energy drink in official GTA 6 videos, widely read as Monster Energy, and also as Red Bull or Mountain Dew.
Fashion label in official GTA 6 videos, widely read as probably Balenciaga and Vetements.
Car maker in official GTA 6 videos, a parody of Mitsubishi.
Motorcycle maker in official GTA 6 videos, widely read as probably Kawasaki.
Car maker in official GTA 6 videos, a parody of Audi.
